in-finance-commission.name: Sixteenth Finance Commission
in-finance-commission.description: Recommended how the Union divides net tax proceeds between itself and the states (vertical devolution) and among the states (horizontal devolution), and the principles for grants-in-aid and local-body/disaster grants, for the five-year award period 2026-27 to 2030-31.
in-finance-commission.legalBasis: Article 280 of the Constitution; Finance Commission (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act, 1951
in-finance-commission.hq: Jawahar Vyapar Bhawan, Tolstoy Marg, New Delhi
in-finance-commission.head: in-pos-chair-finance-commission
in-finance-commission.notes: r2 findings from the official Report of the Sixteenth Finance Commission (Vol I - Main Report, 'Report for 2026-31'; PDF last-modified 2026-02-01 per fincomindia.nic.in server headers; the council's own homepage confirms 'Sixteenth Finance Commission Report tabled in Parliament'; the exact day of submission to the President / tabling in Parliament was not found in machine-readable text on the site and is NOT invented here — treat 'tabled ~Feb 2026' as month-level confidence only). Award period: 2026-27 to 2030-31 (fiscal), confirmed. Vertical devolution recommendation: Chapter 7, para 7.68 of the report states verbatim: 'Presently, for its award period, the Commission recommends retaining the States' share in the divisible pool at its current level of 41 per cent' — i.e. NO change from the Fifteenth Finance Commission's 41%. Seventeenth Finance Commission: no evidence found that it has been constituted as of 2026-09-25 — en.wikipedia.org has no 'Seventeenth Finance Commission' page (checked directly, API returns 'missing'), and fincomindia.nic.in's homepage makes no mention of a 17th FC. The Sixteenth Finance Commission Wikipedia infobox does list a 'Superseding Commission: Seventeenth Finance Commission' field, but this reads as an infobox-template placeholder for 'whichever FC comes next in sequence', not sourced evidence of actual constitution — do not treat as confirmed.

in-gst-council.name: Goods and Services Tax Council
in-gst-council.description: Joint forum of the Union and state finance ministers that recommends GST rates, exemptions, thresholds and administrative rules; decisions require a weighted majority (Union 1/3, states 2/3 of votes cast).
in-gst-council.legalBasis: Article 279A of the Constitution (inserted by the 101st Amendment, 2016)
in-gst-council.head: in-pos-minister-finance
in-gst-council.notes: Chairperson is the Union Finance Minister ex officio (position Minister of Finance, owned by segment council-of-ministers — referenced, not redefined here). Members are the Union Minister of State for Finance and the Finance/other nominated Minister of every state and UT-with-legislature, ex officio; not individually enumerated here. r2: most recent Council meeting confirmed via the Council's own homepage 'What's New' listing is the 56th GST Council meeting, held 3-4 September 2025 in New Delhi (notice for the meeting explicitly dated); a 55th meeting is also referenced as prior. No meeting later than the 56th was found on the official site as of 2026-09-25 — this may mean the site's front page is not fully current rather than that no later meeting occurred; flagged, not asserted either way.

in-gst-council-secretariat.notes: Head-of-secretariat is ex officio the Secretary, Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance — that position record is owned by the ministries-finance segment, not redefined here to avoid a duplicate/conflicting holder record.

in-special-officer-linguistic-minorities.name: Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities (Commissioner for Linguistic Minorities)
in-special-officer-linguistic-minorities.description: A single-officer constitutional post that investigates matters relating to constitutional safeguards for linguistic minorities and reports to the President, who lays the report before Parliament and forwards it to the states concerned.
in-special-officer-linguistic-minorities.head: in-pos-clm
in-special-officer-linguistic-minorities.notes: Office sits administratively under the Ministry of Minority Affairs. r2: could not confirm a current named incumbent via Wikipedia (no dedicated article exists) or via eci/minorityaffairs sources reachable by curl/WebFetch in this pass — the ministry's own site and a dedicated Commissioner-for-Linguistic-Minorities page were not reachable/found. Left unresolved rather than invented, same as round 1.

in-nclm.name: National Commission for Linguistic Minorities (proposed)
in-nclm.description: A statutory National Commission for Linguistic Minorities (to replace/supplement the single Special Officer above) was recommended by the Sachar Committee (2006) and has been proposed in Parliament at various points; it has not been constituted as an operating body as of the source checked.
in-nclm.legalBasis: Proposed; no dedicated constitutional or statutory instrument currently in force
in-nclm.notes: Included per brief's canonical-ID list; NOT a currently operating body — do not treat as staffed. r2: re-checked, still found no evidence this has been constituted as of 2026-09-25.

in-electorate.name: People of India
in-electorate.description: The body of citizens registered on India's electoral rolls. They directly elect the Lok Sabha (and State Legislative Assemblies) under Article 326 universal adult suffrage, and indirectly elect the President and Vice-President through their elected representatives.

in-nsc.description: India's apex body for national security and strategic policy, chaired by the Prime Minister. Its three tiers are the Strategic Policy Group, the National Security Advisory Board, and the National Security Council Secretariat.

in-nsab.head: in-pos-chairman-nsab

in-raw.name: Research and Analysis Wing
in-raw.description: India's primary foreign-intelligence agency, responsible for external intelligence gathering, counter-terrorism abroad and covert operations. in-ntro.name: National Technical Research Organisation
in-ntro.description: India's technical-intelligence agency, handling SIGINT, remote sensing, cyber security and cryptology for the security establishment. Set up on the recommendation of the Cabinet Committee on Security; reports to the NSA and PMO.
in-ntro.legalBasis: Cabinet Committee on Security approval, October 2004
in-ntro.head: in-pos-chairman-ntro

in-niti-aayog.name: NITI Aayog
in-niti-aayog.description: The Union Government's premier public-policy think tank, which replaced the Planning Commission in 2015. in-union-council-of-ministers.name: Union Council of Ministers

in-union-cabinet.name: Union Cabinet

in-inter-state-council.name: Inter-State Council
in-inter-state-council.description: A recommendatory (non-statutory, non-permanent) body set up under Article 263 to investigate and discuss subjects of common interest between the Union and States, or among States. Chaired by the Prime Minister; members are all State Chief Ministers, Chief Ministers/Administrators of UTs, Governors of States under President's Rule, and 6 Union Cabinet Ministers nominated by the PM. Its Standing Committee is chaired by the Union Home Minister.
in-inter-state-council.legalBasis: Article 263, Constitution of India; Presidential Order of 28 May 1990
in-inter-state-council.head: in-pos-prime-minister

in-zonal-council-northern.name: Northern Zonal Council
in-zonal-council-northern.description: Statutory advisory body under Part III of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 for coordination among member States/UTs: Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Rajasthan, and the UTs of Chandigarh, Delhi, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh. Chaired by the Union Home Minister; member States' Chief Ministers serve as Vice-Chairman on an annual rotating basis.

in-zonal-council-central.name: Central Zonal Council
in-zonal-council-central.description: Statutory advisory body under Part III of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 for coordination among member States/UTs: Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand. Chaired by the Union Home Minister; member States' Chief Ministers serve as Vice-Chairman on an annual rotating basis.

in-zonal-council-eastern.name: Eastern Zonal Council
in-zonal-council-eastern.description: Statutory advisory body under Part III of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 for coordination among member States/UTs: Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, West Bengal. Chaired by the Union Home Minister; member States' Chief Ministers serve as Vice-Chairman on an annual rotating basis.

in-zonal-council-western.name: Western Zonal Council

in-zonal-council-southern.name: Southern Zonal Council
in-zonal-council-southern.description: Statutory advisory body under Part III of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 for coordination among member States/UTs: Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, and (as special invitees) the UTs of Puducherry, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep. Chaired by the Union Home Minister; member States' Chief Ministers serve as Vice-Chairman on an annual rotating basis.

in-nec.name: North Eastern Council

in-supreme-court-collegium.name: Collegium of the Supreme Court of India
in-supreme-court-collegium.description: An extra-constitutional, judge-only body — the Chief Justice of India and the four next most senior Supreme Court judges — that recommends appointments and transfers of judges to the Supreme Court and High Courts. Evolved through the Second and Third Judges Cases (1993, 1998); the executive cannot appoint a judge outside a collegium recommendation, though it can return a name once for reconsideration.
in-supreme-court-collegium.legalBasis: Judge-made law: Supreme Court Advocates-on-Record Association v Union of India (1993) and In re Special Reference 1 of 1998 (interpreting Article 124(2))

in-supreme-court-registry.name: Registry of the Supreme Court of India
in-supreme-court-registry.description: The administrative and case-management arm of the Supreme Court, headed by the Secretary General and staffed by Registrars and Registrars (Judicial) who handle filing, listing, court records and day-to-day administration.

in-sclsc.name: Supreme Court Legal Services Committee
in-sclsc.description: Provides free legal aid, advice and representation to eligible weaker-section litigants in cases before the Supreme Court, and runs Lok Adalats and mediation for such matters. Chaired by a sitting Supreme Court judge (nominated by the CJI) with nine CJI-nominated members; the Attorney General and the Secretary General of the Supreme Court are ex-officio members.

in-nalsa.name: National Legal Services Authority
in-nalsa.description: The apex statutory body constituted to provide free legal aid to weaker sections of society, organise Lok Adalats and promote access to justice nationwide; oversees the State/District Legal Services Authorities. The sitting CJI is ex-officio Patron-in-Chief; the senior-most sitting Supreme Court judge after the CJI is Executive Chairman.
in-nalsa.head: in-pos-executive-chairman-nalsa

in-nja.name: National Judicial Academy
in-nja.description: The apex judicial-training institution of India, on a 63-acre campus at Bhopal; trains judges and judicial officers and conducts research on judicial administration. Registered as a society in 1993; its Governing Council is chaired by the Chief Justice of India.
in-nja.legalBasis: Registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860

in-ecommittee-sc.name: e-Committee, Supreme Court of India
in-ecommittee-sc.description: Advises the Chief Justice of India on the national policy for information and communication technology (ICT) in the Indian judiciary, and plans/monitors the eCourts Mission Mode Project across all courts.
in-ecommittee-sc.legalBasis: Constituted by the Supreme Court of India (Government of India Resolution, 2004)
in-ecommittee-sc.head: in-pos-chairperson-ecommittee-sc

members.title: Vice-Chairperson, e-Committee, Supreme Court of India

holder.name: Anjani Kumar Mishra
holder.notes: Retired High Court judge; not a sitting Supreme Court judge.

in-ngt.name: National Green Tribunal
in-ngt.description: Specialised statutory tribunal for expeditious disposal of civil cases involving substantial questions relating to protection of environment and natural resources, and for providing relief and compensation for damages to persons and property from environmental harm.
in-ngt.head: in-pos-chairperson-ngt

in-nclt.name: National Company Law Tribunal
in-nclt.description: Quasi-judicial body adjudicating company-law matters: insolvency resolution and liquidation of companies/LLPs under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016, oppression and mismanagement, mergers, amalgamations and winding-up of companies.
in-nclt.legalBasis: Companies Act, 2013 (Section 408); also functions as Adjudicating Authority under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016
in-nclt.head: in-pos-president-nclt

stats.note: Wikipedia (2021-era update) described 16 physical benches across these cities (Delhi hosting multiple); exact current per-city bench count not independently re-confirmed.

in-nclat.name: National Company Law Appellate Tribunal
in-nclat.description: Appellate tribunal hearing appeals against NCLT orders (including IBC insolvency/liquidation matters) and against orders/directions of the Competition Commission of India and the National Financial Reporting Authority. Its orders are appealable to the Supreme Court.
in-nclat.head: in-pos-chairperson-nclat

in-itat.name: Income Tax Appellate Tribunal
in-itat.description: Second appellate authority under the direct-tax statutes and the first independent forum in the direct-tax appellate hierarchy; its orders are final except where a substantial question of law arises for the High Court.
in-itat.legalBasis: Income-tax Act, 1961 (Section 252); originally constituted 1941 under the Income Tax Act, 1922 (Section 5A)
in-itat.head: in-pos-president-itat

stats.note: Exact current total bench count not independently re-confirmed in this research pass; ITAT began in 1941 with 3 benches (Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai) and has expanded substantially since.

in-cat.name: Central Administrative Tribunal
in-cat.description: Adjudicates disputes and complaints relating to recruitment and conditions of service of persons appointed to central public services and posts (and some state government employees under specified arrangements), functioning with powers similar to a High Court in its own contempt proceedings.
in-cat.head: in-pos-chairman-cat

stats.note: 1 Chairman + up to 34 Judicial + 35 Administrative members per Wikipedia; cgat.gov.in is a client-rendered site and could not be independently scraped to corroborate this figure.

in-aft.name: Armed Forces Tribunal
in-aft.description: Military tribunal adjudicating disputes and complaints on service and conditions of service of Army, Navy and Air Force personnel, and hearing appeals from orders, findings or sentences of courts-martial.
in-aft.head: in-pos-chairperson-aft

stats.note: Principal Bench (Delhi) plus 10 regional benches per Wikipedia.

in-cestat.name: Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal
in-cestat.description: Quasi-judicial body hearing appeals against orders passed under the Customs Act 1962 and Central Excise Act 1944 (and, for the pre-GST period, service tax under the Finance Act 1994); also has appellate jurisdiction in anti-dumping matters against orders of the Designated Authority in the Ministry of Commerce.
in-cestat.legalBasis: Customs Act, 1962 (Section 129), as amended by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 1980 and Finance Act, 2003
in-cestat.head: in-pos-president-cestat

in-aptel.name: Appellate Tribunal for Electricity
in-aptel.description: Statutory and autonomous body hearing appeals against orders of the Central and State Electricity Regulatory Commissions and the adjudicating officer under the Electricity Act; since 2007 also the appellate forum for orders of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB). Second appeal on substantial questions of law lies to the Supreme Court.
in-aptel.head: in-pos-chairperson-aptel

in-tdsat.name: Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate Tribunal
in-tdsat.description: Adjudicates disputes between telecom service providers and between service providers and consumers, and hears appeals against directions, decisions or orders of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI); also has jurisdiction over broadcasting and cable services disputes.
in-tdsat.legalBasis: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 (as amended by the TRAI (Amendment) Act, 2000)
in-tdsat.head: in-pos-chairperson-tdsat

in-sat.name: Securities Appellate Tribunal
in-sat.description: Hears appeals against orders passed by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) and the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA).
in-sat.legalBasis: Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 (Section 15K)
in-sat.head: in-pos-presiding-officer-sat

in-ncdrc.name: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
in-ncdrc.description: Apex quasi-judicial body of India's three-tier consumer-dispute-redressal system; entertains complaints above the top pecuniary threshold and exercises appellate and revisional jurisdiction over State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions.
in-ncdrc.legalBasis: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (originally constituted 1988 under the Consumer Protection Act, 1986)
in-ncdrc.head: in-pos-president-ncdrc

stats.note: President + 9 other members, per Wikipedia 'as of 2024'.

in-drat.name: Debts Recovery Appellate Tribunals
in-drat.description: Appellate tier hearing appeals against orders of the Debts Recovery Tribunals on recovery of debts owed to banks and financial institutions, and enforcement actions under the SARFAESI Act. 5 DRATs function across India, each headed by its own Chairperson (retired/serving High Court judge) — no single national head.
in-drat.legalBasis: Recovery of Debts and Bankruptcy Act, 1993 (RDB Act); Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Security Interest (SARFAESI) Act, 2002

in-drt.name: Debts Recovery Tribunals
in-drt.description: First-tier tribunals for expeditious adjudication of claims by banks and financial institutions for recovery of debts, and for related enforcement matters under the SARFAESI Act. 39 DRTs function across India, each headed by its own Presiding Officer — no single national head.
in-drt.legalBasis: Recovery of Debts and Bankruptcy Act, 1993 (RDB Act, formerly the Recovery of Debts Due to Banks and Financial Institutions Act, 1993)

in-gstat.name: Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal
in-gstat.description: Second appellate authority for GST disputes, hearing appeals against orders of Appellate/Revisional authorities under Sections 107/108 of the CGST Act and corresponding State GST Acts; became operational with e-filing and a Principal Bench plus State Benches during 2025-26, with its e-Journal reporting judgements up to end-August 2026.
in-gstat.legalBasis: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (Section 109)
in-gstat.head: in-pos-president-gstat

stats.operationalStatus2025_26: Operational — GSTAT Procedure Rules 2025 and Anti-Profiteering Procedure Rules 2025 notified; e-Filing portal live; e-Journal reporting judgements through 2026-08-31.

in-rct.name: Railway Claims Tribunal
in-rct.description: Adjudicates claims for compensation for death or injury to rail passengers, and for loss, destruction, damage, deterioration or non-delivery of goods/parcels/luggage carried by the railways; each bench has its own Chairman/Members — no single national head.

stats.note: Site notice (Feb 2026) says the Tribunal is migrating its case-filing system to https://erct.gov.in

in-cgit.name: Central Government Industrial Tribunals-cum-Labour Courts
in-cgit.description: Adjudicate industrial disputes referred by the Central Government under the Industrial Disputes Act for establishments in the central sphere (railways, banks, ports, mines, major PSUs, etc.); administered through the office of the Chief Labour Commissioner (Central). No single national head — each CGIT-cum-LC is headed by its own Presiding Officer.

in-local-government.name: Local Government of India (aggregate)
in-local-government.description: The national aggregate of all rural and urban local self-government bodies in India: village, intermediate and district-level Panchayati Raj Institutions (Part IX) and urban local bodies (Part IXA), as tracked in the Ministry of Panchayati Raj's Local Government Directory (LGD).
in-local-government.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (Panchayats) and Part IXA (Municipalities), inserted by the 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendment Acts, 1992
in-local-government.notes: Live counters read from the lgdirectory.gov.in homepage dashboard on 2026-09-25 (public, no login/CAPTCHA required for this summary view). Urban Local Bodies total (5051) does not exactly equal the sum of the three listed categories (273+2006+2420=4699); the ~352 balance is presumably other ULB categories (e.g. cantonment boards, notified area committees, industrial townships) not broken out on the dashboard. Districts total here (784) is LGD's officially-coded count; our district entity list below (788) is slightly higher because it follows Wikipedia's 'List of districts in India' and includes a handful of newly announced/renamed districts (e.g. Goa's Kushavati, Andhra Pradesh's Polavaram and Markapuram) that a few states have notified but that had not yet received formal LGD codes as of this fetch — flagged individually via a missing censusDistrictCode/low confidence where applicable.

in-dept-expenditure.name: Department of Expenditure
in-dept-expenditure.description: Oversees the public financial management system, releases and monitors government spending, implements Finance Commission and Pay Commission awards, and issues General Financial Rules. Houses the Controller General of Accounts.
in-dept-expenditure.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-dept-expenditure.head: in-pos-cga

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-revenue.name: Department of Revenue
in-dept-revenue.description: Administers direct taxes through the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) and indirect taxes (GST, customs) through the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC), and oversees the Enforcement Directorate, Financial Intelligence Unit and other anti-evasion agencies.
in-dept-revenue.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Central Boards of Revenue Act, 1963

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-financial-services.name: Department of Financial Services
in-dept-financial-services.description: Administers the Union government's ownership of public sector banks, insurers and financial institutions; sets policy on banking reform, financial inclusion (Jan Dhan, credit guarantee schemes) and coordinates with financial-sector regulators.
in-dept-financial-services.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-investment-and-public-asset-mana.name: Department of Investment and Public Asset Management
in-dept-investment-and-public-asset-mana.description: Manages the Union government's equity holdings in central public sector enterprises and executes disinvestment, strategic sale and asset-monetisation transactions.
in-dept-investment-and-public-asset-mana.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-public-enterprises.name: Department of Public Enterprises
in-dept-public-enterprises.description: Formulates policy for central public sector enterprises (CPSEs), including the Maharatna/Navratna/Miniratna classification, corporate-governance guidelines, pay scales and performance (MoU) evaluation. Administratively placed under the Ministry of Finance.
in-dept-public-enterprises.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-min-corporate-affairs.name: Ministry of Corporate Affairs
in-min-corporate-affairs.description: Administers the Companies Act 2013 and the Limited Liability Partnership Act 2008 — company incorporation and registration (via MCA21), corporate governance, insolvency policy, and regulation of the accounting and company-secretary professions.
in-min-corporate-affairs.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Companies Act, 2013; Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008
in-min-corporate-affairs.head: in-pos-minister-corporate-affairs

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Corporate Affairs

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-min-commerce-and-industry.name: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
in-min-commerce-and-industry.description: Formulates and negotiates India's foreign trade policy and trade agreements, promotes exports and domestic/foreign investment, and drives industrial policy, through its two departments.
in-min-commerce-and-industry.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-commerce-and-industry.head: in-pos-minister-commerce-and-industry

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Commerce and Industry

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-commerce.name: Department of Commerce
in-dept-commerce.description: Negotiates bilateral and multilateral trade agreements, administers export-promotion schemes and commodity boards (tea, coffee, rubber, spices, tobacco), and regulates foreign trade through the DGFT and DGTR.
in-dept-commerce.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-promotion-of-industry-and-intern.name: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
in-dept-promotion-of-industry-and-intern.description: Formulates industrial and FDI policy, drives Ease of Doing Business and Make in India, administers intellectual-property administration (patents, designs, trademarks, GIs) through the CGPDTM, and runs the Startup India initiative.
in-dept-promotion-of-industry-and-intern.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-min-statistics-and-programme-implemen.name: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
in-min-statistics-and-programme-implemen.description: Produces India's official statistics — GDP and national accounts, the Consumer Price Index, periodic labour-force and household surveys — through the National Statistical Office, and monitors the physical and financial progress of central infrastructure projects.
in-min-statistics-and-programme-implemen.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Collection of Statistics Act, 2008

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-min-planning.name: Ministry of Planning
in-min-planning.description: Nominal successor to the erstwhile Planning Commission's ministerial function. Since the Planning Commission's 2015 replacement by NITI Aayog (owned by core segment, see in-niti-aayog), the Ministry of Planning has no separate executing machinery of its own and is held by the same Minister of State (Independent Charge) as Statistics & Programme Implementation.
in-min-planning.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-min-micro-small-and-medium-enterprise.name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
in-min-micro-small-and-medium-enterprise.description: Formulates policy and implements credit, technology-upgradation and cluster-development schemes for India's micro, small and medium enterprises, and promotes khadi and village industries.
in-min-micro-small-and-medium-enterprise.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006
in-min-micro-small-and-medium-enterprise.head: in-pos-minister-micro-small-and-medium-enterprises

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-cbdt.name: Central Board of Direct Taxes
in-cbdt.description: Apex statutory body that administers direct taxes (income tax, corporate tax) in India, formulates policy, and oversees the Income Tax Department's field administration.
in-cbdt.head: in-pos-chairman-cbdt

in-cbic.name: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
aliases: Central Board of Excise and Customs
in-cbic.description: Apex statutory body that administers GST (Union component), customs duties and central excise, and enforces trade-facilitation and anti-smuggling law.
in-cbic.head: in-pos-chairman-cbic

in-dggi.name: Directorate General of GST Intelligence
in-dggi.description: CBIC's intelligence and enforcement arm against GST evasion, fake invoicing and input-tax-credit fraud.
in-dggi.legalBasis: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

in-dri.name: Directorate of Revenue Intelligence
in-dri.description: India's premier anti-smuggling intelligence and investigation agency, enforcing the Customs Act against smuggling of contraband, gold, narcotics and commercial fraud.

in-ed.name: Enforcement Directorate
in-ed.description: Investigates and prosecutes offences of money laundering under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act and violations of foreign-exchange law under FEMA; also handles fugitive economic offender proceedings.
in-ed.legalBasis: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002; Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999

in-fiu-ind.name: Financial Intelligence Unit - India
in-fiu-ind.description: National central agency that receives, analyses and disseminates information on suspicious financial transactions to law-enforcement and intelligence agencies to combat money laundering and terror financing.

in-ceib.name: Central Economic Intelligence Bureau
in-ceib.description: Apex coordinating agency for economic intelligence among revenue and enforcement agencies (Income Tax, Customs, ED, DRI, FIU) under the Department of Revenue.
in-ceib.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-nacin.name: National Academy of Customs, Indirect Taxes and Narcotics
in-nacin.description: Apex training institute for CBIC (customs, GST) officers and for capacity-building in partner countries.
in-nacin.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-nadt.name: National Academy of Direct Taxes
in-nadt.description: Apex training institute for Indian Revenue Service (Income Tax) officers, based in Nagpur.
in-nadt.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-gstn.name: Goods and Services Tax Network
in-gstn.description: Non-profit, non-government company that builds and operates the IT backbone for GST registration, returns and invoice matching for the Union and all states.
in-gstn.legalBasis: Companies Act, 2013 (Section 8 company); GST Council decisions

in-dgft.name: Directorate General of Foreign Trade
in-dgft.description: Implements India's Foreign Trade Policy — issues import-export codes, export/import licences and incentive scrips, and regulates foreign trade.
in-dgft.head: in-pos-dg-dgft

in-dgtr.name: Directorate General of Trade Remedies
aliases: Directorate General of Anti-Dumping and Allied Duties
in-dgtr.description: Investigates and recommends anti-dumping, countervailing and safeguard duties to protect Indian industry from injurious/unfair imports.
in-dgtr.head: in-pos-dg-dgtr

in-dgcis.name: Directorate General of Commercial Intelligence and Statistics
in-dgcis.description: Compiles and publishes India's official foreign-trade statistics (exports/imports by commodity and country) based on customs data.
in-dgcis.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-cgpdtm.name: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks
in-cgpdtm.description: India's national intellectual-property office — administers the grant of patents, trademarks, designs and geographical indications.
in-cgpdtm.legalBasis: Patents Act, 1970; Trade Marks Act, 1999; Designs Act, 2000; Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999
in-cgpdtm.head: in-pos-cgpdtm

in-nso.name: National Statistical Office
in-nso.description: Produces India's official statistics — GDP and national-accounts estimates, the Consumer Price Index, Periodic Labour Force Survey and other household surveys. Merger of the former Central Statistics Office (CSO) and National Sample Survey Office (NSSO).

in-isi.name: Indian Statistical Institute
in-isi.description: Institute of national importance for research, teaching and application of statistics, headquartered in Kolkata; administratively under MoSPI.

in-icai.name: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India
in-icai.description: Statutory regulator and professional body for chartered accountants in India — conducts the CA examinations, sets accounting/auditing standards guidance, and enforces professional discipline.

in-icsi.name: Institute of Company Secretaries of India
in-icsi.description: Statutory regulator and professional body for company secretaries in India.

in-icmai.name: Institute of Cost Accountants of India
in-icmai.description: Statutory regulator and professional body for cost and management accountants in India.

in-nfra.name: National Financial Reporting Authority
in-nfra.description: Independent regulator overseeing auditing standards and audit quality for listed and large companies, with powers to investigate and discipline auditors — created after major corporate-fraud/audit-failure cases.
in-nfra.head: in-pos-chairperson-nfra

in-sfio.name: Serious Fraud Investigation Office
in-sfio.description: Multi-disciplinary investigative agency that probes serious and complex corporate fraud under the Companies Act.
in-sfio.head: in-pos-director-sfio

in-iepfa.name: Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority
in-iepfa.description: Administers the Investor Education and Protection Fund — holds unclaimed dividends, matured deposits and shares transferred from companies, refunds claims to investors, and runs investor-awareness programmes.
in-iepfa.head: in-pos-chairperson-iepfa

in-iica.name: Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs
in-iica.description: Think-tank, training and research institute of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs on corporate governance, CSR, competition law and insolvency.

in-tea-board.name: Tea Board of India
in-tea-board.description: Regulates and promotes the Indian tea industry — production, quality, research and export promotion.
in-tea-board.head: in-pos-chairman-tea-board

in-coffee-board.name: Coffee Board of India
in-coffee-board.description: Regulates and promotes the Indian coffee industry — research, development, extension and export/market promotion.
in-coffee-board.head: in-pos-chairman-coffee-board

in-rubber-board.name: Rubber Board (India)
in-rubber-board.description: Regulates and promotes the Indian natural-rubber industry — research, extension, replanting subsidies and market intervention.
in-rubber-board.head: in-pos-chairman-rubber-board

in-spices-board.name: Spices Board of India
in-spices-board.description: Promotes export and quality development of Indian spices and administers spice-export regulation.
in-spices-board.head: in-pos-chairman-spices-board

in-tobacco-board.name: Tobacco Board
in-tobacco-board.description: Regulates tobacco production and export, and administers auction platforms for Virginia tobacco.
in-tobacco-board.head: in-pos-chairman-tobacco-board

in-apeda.name: Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority
in-apeda.description: Promotes export of agricultural and processed-food products, sets quality/packaging standards, and registers exporters.
in-apeda.legalBasis: Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority Act, 1985
in-apeda.head: in-pos-chairman-apeda

in-mpeda.name: Marine Products Export Development Authority
in-mpeda.description: Promotes export of marine products (shrimp, fish) — quality control, infrastructure development and market promotion.
in-mpeda.legalBasis: Marine Products Export Development Authority Act, 1972
in-mpeda.head: in-pos-chairman-mpeda

in-iift.name: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade
in-iift.description: Deemed-to-be university and training/research institute on international trade, under the Department of Commerce.
in-iift.legalBasis: Societies Registration Act, 1860 (registered society); deemed university status under UGC Act

in-nid.name: National Institute of Design
in-nid.description: Institute of national importance for design education and research, with its main campus in Ahmedabad.

in-fddi.name: Footwear Design and Development Institute
in-fddi.description: Autonomous institute for footwear design, leather-goods and retail-management education under DPIIT.
in-fddi.legalBasis: Footwear Design and Development Institute Act, 2017

in-qci.name: Quality Council of India
in-qci.description: National accreditation body set up jointly by government and industry associations to establish and operate accreditation and quality-certification structures across sectors.
in-qci.legalBasis: Registered as a not-for-profit autonomous society
in-qci.head: in-pos-chairman-qci

in-npc.name: National Productivity Council
in-npc.description: National productivity-promotion body providing consultancy, training and research to industry and government; the Commerce & Industry Minister is ex officio President and the DPIIT Secretary is ex officio Chairman.

in-invest-india.name: Invest India
in-invest-india.description: India's national investment-promotion and facilitation agency, operated as a not-for-profit venture between DPIIT, industry associations and state governments.

in-kvic.name: Khadi and Village Industries Commission
in-kvic.description: Statutory body that plans, promotes, organises and finances khadi and village industries and supports their development.
in-kvic.legalBasis: Khadi and Village Industries Commission Act, 1956
in-kvic.head: in-pos-chairman-kvic

in-coir-board.name: Coir Board
in-coir-board.description: Promotes development of the coir industry — research, export promotion, and welfare of coir workers.
in-coir-board.head: in-pos-chairman-coir-board

in-ni-msme.name: National Institute for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
in-ni-msme.description: National-level training, research, consultancy and extension organisation for the MSME sector, based in Hyderabad.

in-mgiri.name: Mahatma Gandhi Institute for Rural Industrialization
in-mgiri.description: Research institute under KVIC/MSME for rural-industry technology development, based in Wardha.

in-cgtmse.name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises
in-cgtmse.description: Trust set up jointly by the Ministry of MSME and SIDBI to provide collateral-free credit guarantees to lenders financing micro and small enterprises.
in-cgtmse.legalBasis: Trust established under Indian Trusts Act, 1882

in-pesb.name: Public Enterprises Selection Board
in-pesb.description: Recommends candidates for top-management posts (Chairman, Managing Director, functional Director) in central public sector enterprises, for final appointment by the government.
in-pesb.legalBasis: Government of India Resolution (1987, as amended)
in-pesb.head: in-pos-chairperson-pesb

in-fsib.name: Financial Services Institutions Bureau
in-fsib.description: Recommends candidates for top-management posts (Chairman, MD & CEO, Executive Director) in public sector banks, financial institutions and public sector insurers; successor to the Banks Board Bureau (BBB).
in-fsib.legalBasis: Government of India Resolution (2022, superseding the 2016 BBB resolution)
in-fsib.head: in-pos-chairman-fsib

in-scope.name: Standing Conference of Public Enterprises
in-scope.description: Apex professional body/registered society of central public sector enterprises that advises government on CPSE policy and provides a forum for CPSEs.

in-mmtc.name: MMTC Limited
in-mmtc.description: Miniratna CPSE trading company — India's largest bullion importer and a canalising agency for select mineral, metal and agri-commodity trade.
in-mmtc.head: in-pos-cmd-mmtc

in-stc.name: State Trading Corporation of India
in-stc.description: CPSE trading company historically canalising bulk import/export of essential commodities; now diversified into trading and leasing.
in-stc.head: in-pos-cmd-stc

in-pec-limited.name: PEC Limited
in-pec-limited.description: CPSE trading company engaged in international trade of agricultural commodities, metals, coal and general goods.
in-pec-limited.head: in-pos-cmd-pec

in-ecgc.name: Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India
in-ecgc.description: Provides export-credit insurance and guarantee cover to Indian exporters and banks against payment-default risk on overseas trade.
in-ecgc.head: in-pos-cmd-ecgc

in-itpo.name: India Trade Promotion Organisation
in-itpo.description: Premier trade-promotion body — organises India's international trade fairs and exhibitions (e.g. India International Trade Fair) and runs Pragati Maidan.
in-itpo.head: in-pos-cmd-itpo

in-nsic.name: National Small Industries Corporation
in-nsic.description: Miniratna CPSE promoting the growth of micro and small enterprises through credit, raw-material, marketing and technology support.
in-nsic.head: in-pos-cmd-nsic

in-spmcil.name: Security Printing and Minting Corporation of India Limited
in-spmcil.description: Miniratna CPSE that produces currency and bank notes, security paper, coins, non-judicial stamp papers and passports/travel documents through its mints and presses.
in-spmcil.head: in-pos-cmd-spmcil

in-ifci.name: IFCI Limited
in-ifci.description: India's oldest development finance institution, now a government-owned NBFC financing industrial and infrastructure projects.
in-ifci.legalBasis: Companies Act (formerly a statutory corporation under the IFCI Act, 1948, corporatised in 1993)

in-iifcl.name: India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited
in-iifcl.description: Wholly government-owned company providing long-term debt finance for infrastructure projects.

in-nabfid.name: National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development
in-nabfid.description: Development financial institution set up to fund long-term infrastructure projects, catalyse private infrastructure investment and develop the bond market for infrastructure financing.
in-nabfid.legalBasis: National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development Act, 2021

in-niif.name: National Investment and Infrastructure Fund
in-niif.description: India's quasi-sovereign wealth fund that invests, alongside domestic and global institutional investors, in infrastructure and other sectors.
in-niif.legalBasis: Category-II Alternative Investment Fund registered with SEBI

in-ncgtc.name: National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company
in-ncgtc.description: Government-owned trustee company that manages several credit-guarantee trust funds (for education loans, skill-development loans, MSME/start-up credit, and Covid-era emergency credit schemes).

in-dicgc.name: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation
in-dicgc.description: Insures bank deposits up to a statutory limit (₹5 lakh per depositor per bank) for all commercial and most cooperative banks. Wholly owned subsidiary of the Reserve Bank of India; included here for its close administrative interface with DFS on bank depositor-protection policy.
in-dicgc.legalBasis: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation Act, 1961

in-sbi.name: State Bank of India
in-sbi.description: Public sector bank, majority-owned by the Government of India through the Department of Financial Services.
in-sbi.head: in-pos-ceo-sbi

in-pnb.name: Punjab National Bank
in-pnb.description: Public sector bank, majority-owned by the Government of India through the Department of Financial Services.
in-pnb.legalBasis: Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1970 or 1980 (bank was nationalised in the 1969 or 1980 tranche; exact tranche not verified per-bank in this pass), consolidated through subsequent bank mergers (2017-2020)

in-indian-bank.legalBasis: Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1970 or 1980 (bank was nationalised in the 1969 or 1980 tranche; exact tranche not verified per-bank in this pass), consolidated through subsequent bank mergers (2017-2020)

in-bank-of-india.legalBasis: Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1970 or 1980 (bank was nationalised in the 1969 or 1980 tranche; exact tranche not verified per-bank in this pass), consolidated through subsequent bank mergers (2017-2020)
in-bank-of-india.head: in-pos-ceo-bank-of-india

in-central-bank-of-india.legalBasis: Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1970 or 1980 (bank was nationalised in the 1969 or 1980 tranche; exact tranche not verified per-bank in this pass), consolidated through subsequent bank mergers (2017-2020)

in-indian-overseas-bank.description: Public sector bank, majority-owned by the Government of India through the Department of Financial Services.
in-indian-overseas-bank.legalBasis: Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1970 or 1980 (bank was nationalised in the 1969 or 1980 tranche; exact tranche not verified per-bank in this pass), consolidated through subsequent bank mergers (2017-2020)
