in-uco-bank.head: in-pos-ceo-uco-bank

in-bank-of-maharashtra.name: Bank of Maharashtra
in-bank-of-maharashtra.description: Public sector bank, majority-owned by the Government of India through the Department of Financial Services.
in-bank-of-maharashtra.legalBasis: Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1970 or 1980 (bank was nationalised in the 1969 or 1980 tranche; exact tranche not verified per-bank in this pass), consolidated through subsequent bank mergers (2017-2020)
in-bank-of-maharashtra.head: in-pos-ceo-bank-of-maharashtra

in-punjab-and-sind-bank.name: Punjab & Sind Bank
in-punjab-and-sind-bank.description: Public sector bank, majority-owned by the Government of India through the Department of Financial Services.
in-punjab-and-sind-bank.legalBasis: Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1970 or 1980 (bank was nationalised in the 1969 or 1980 tranche; exact tranche not verified per-bank in this pass), consolidated through subsequent bank mergers (2017-2020)
in-punjab-and-sind-bank.head: in-pos-ceo-punjab-and-sind-bank

in-lic.name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
in-lic.description: India's largest life insurer, a statutory corporation wholly owned by the Government of India; also one of India's largest institutional investors.
in-lic.head: in-pos-ceo-lic

in-gic-re.name: General Insurance Corporation of India
in-gic-re.description: India's national reinsurer, providing reinsurance capacity to domestic non-life insurers; also holds residual equity in the public-sector general insurers it formerly held as subsidiaries.
in-gic-re.head: in-pos-ceo-gic-re

in-new-india-assurance.name: New India Assurance Company Limited
in-new-india-assurance.description: Public sector general/life insurer, wholly or majority-owned by the Government of India.
in-new-india-assurance.head: in-pos-ceo-new-india-assurance

in-national-insurance-company.name: National Insurance Company Limited
in-national-insurance-company.description: Public sector general/life insurer, wholly or majority-owned by the Government of India.
in-national-insurance-company.head: in-pos-ceo-national-insurance-company

in-oriental-insurance.name: Oriental Insurance Company Limited
in-oriental-insurance.description: Public sector general/life insurer, wholly or majority-owned by the Government of India.
in-oriental-insurance.head: in-pos-ceo-oriental-insurance

in-united-india-insurance.name: United India Insurance Company Limited
in-united-india-insurance.description: Public sector general/life insurer, wholly or majority-owned by the Government of India.
in-united-india-insurance.head: in-pos-ceo-united-india-insurance

in-aic.name: Agriculture Insurance Company of India Limited
in-aic.description: Specialised public sector insurer implementing crop-insurance schemes (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana and predecessors).
in-aic.head: in-pos-ceo-aic

in-board-of-trade.name: Board of Trade
in-board-of-trade.description: Apex advisory body, chaired by the Commerce & Industry Minister, that advises government on foreign trade policy issues raised by export/industry associations and state governments.
in-board-of-trade.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-fieo.name: Federation of Indian Export Organisations
in-fieo.description: Apex body of India's export-promotion councils and export organisations; works closely with the Department of Commerce on trade-policy advocacy, though it is industry-run rather than a government body.

in-startup-india.name: Startup India
in-startup-india.description: Flagship DPIIT initiative to build a start-up ecosystem — DPIIT recognition, tax benefits, the Fund of Funds for Startups (via SIDBI), and simplified compliance for registered start-ups.

in-pm-gatishakti.name: PM GatiShakti National Master Plan
in-pm-gatishakti.description: National multi-modal connectivity master plan coordinating infrastructure planning across ministries via a GIS platform; the Network Planning Group is housed in DPIIT.

in-pm-vishwakarma.name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
in-pm-vishwakarma.description: Central sector scheme providing recognition, skill training, toolkit incentives and collateral-free credit to traditional artisans and craftspeople (18 trades).

in-pmegp.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
in-pmegp.description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up new micro-enterprises, implemented through KVIC, KVI Boards and District Industries Centres.
in-pmegp.legalBasis: Government scheme (2008, merger of REGP and PMRY)

in-bnpmipl.name: Bank Note Paper Mill India Private Limited
in-bnpmipl.description: Joint-venture company between SPMCIL and the Reserve Bank of India (via Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran) that manufactures currency-note paper at Mysuru.

in-nifm.name: National Institute of Financial Management
in-nifm.description: Autonomous training and research institute for public financial management, training officers of the Indian Civil Accounts Service and other central/state finance officials.

in-pmla-adjudicating-authority.name: Adjudicating Authority (PMLA)
in-pmla-adjudicating-authority.description: Quasi-judicial authority that confirms or releases provisional attachment of proceeds of crime made by the Enforcement Directorate under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, before appeal lies to the Appellate Tribunal (SAFEMA).
in-pmla-adjudicating-authority.legalBasis: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002, Section 6

in-crc.name: Central Registration Centre
in-crc.description: Processes company and LLP incorporation applications filed through the MCA21 portal on a centralised, jurisdiction-free basis.

in-sez-boa.name: Board of Approval (Special Economic Zones)
in-sez-boa.description: Inter-ministerial body chaired by the Secretary, Department of Commerce, that approves setting up of Special Economic Zones and units within them.

in-nia-insurance.name: National Insurance Academy
in-nia-insurance.description: Apex training, research and education institute for the insurance and pension sector, jointly promoted by public sector insurers, LIC and GIC.

in-iip.name: Indian Institute of Packaging
in-iip.description: National research, training and testing institute for the packaging industry, supporting export-quality packaging standards.

in-gem.name: Government e-Marketplace
in-gem.description: National online public-procurement platform for goods and services used by central and state government buyers, run as a Section 8 not-for-profit company.
in-gem.legalBasis: General Financial Rules, 2017 (Rule 149); registered as a Section 8 company

in-cpao.name: Central Pension Accounting Office
in-cpao.description: Authorises and monitors disbursement of pensions to central civil pensioners through banks, and maintains their pension accounts.
in-cpao.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-nsi-savings.name: National Savings Institute
in-nsi-savings.description: Promotes and administers small-savings schemes (e.g. PPF, National Savings Certificates) on behalf of the Department of Economic Affairs.
in-nsi-savings.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-ingaf.name: Institute of Government Accounts and Finance
in-ingaf.description: Training institute of the Controller General of Accounts for officers of the Indian Civil Accounts Service and government accounting staff.
in-ingaf.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-icegate.name: ICEGATE
in-icegate.description: CBIC's national e-filing portal for customs clearance — bills of entry, shipping bills, e-payment of duty, and exchange of trade data with other government agencies.
in-icegate.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-bharatkosh.name: Bharatkosh (Non-Tax Receipt Portal)
in-bharatkosh.description: Centralised online portal for collection of the Union government's non-tax revenue receipts across ministries.
in-bharatkosh.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-caar.name: Customs Authority for Advance Rulings
in-caar.description: Quasi-judicial authority that issues binding advance rulings on classification, valuation and applicability of customs notifications, to give importers/exporters certainty before a transaction.

in-bar-income-tax.name: Board for Advance Rulings (Income Tax)
in-bar-income-tax.description: Quasi-judicial board that issues binding advance rulings on income-tax liability for a proposed transaction; replaced the Authority for Advance Rulings (Income Tax) from 2021.
in-bar-income-tax.legalBasis: Income-tax Act, 1961, Section 245-O (as amended by Finance Act, 2021)

in-mudra.name: Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency Limited
in-mudra.description: Refinances and supports last-mile lenders (banks, NBFCs, MFIs) making collateral-free micro-loans to non-corporate small business units under the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana; incorporated as a subsidiary of SIDBI.

in-pmjdy.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
in-pmjdy.description: National financial-inclusion mission ensuring access to a basic bank account, RuPay debit card, overdraft facility and insurance cover for every unbanked household, delivered through public sector banks.

in-stand-up-india.name: Stand-Up India Scheme
in-stand-up-india.description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.

in-pfms.name: Public Financial Management System
in-pfms.description: Central government's IT platform tracking real-time release, disbursement and utilisation of funds across all central schemes, from the Controller General of Accounts down to the last-mile beneficiary.
in-pfms.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-cersai.name: Central Registry of Securitisation Asset Reconstruction and Security Interest of India
in-cersai.description: Maintains the central online registry of security interests over property created by banks/financial institutions to prevent multiple, fraudulent lending against the same asset; also operates the Central KYC Records Registry (CKYCR).
in-cersai.legalBasis: Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Security Interest (SARFAESI) Act, 2002

in-fsdc.name: Financial Stability and Development Council
in-fsdc.description: Apex inter-regulatory coordination body chaired by the Finance Minister, bringing together RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, PFRDA and other regulators to monitor macro-prudential and financial-stability risk and coordinate financial-sector development and literacy.

in-min-home-affairs.name: Ministry of Home Affairs
in-min-home-affairs.description: Internal security, policing, borders, Centre-State relations, disaster management, census, citizenship and Union Territory administration for India.
in-min-home-affairs.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-home-affairs.head: in-pos-minister-home-affairs

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Home Affairs
Minister of State in the Ministry of Home Affairs

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-home.name: Department of Home
in-dept-home.description: Core home affairs: internal security coordination, police matters, VIP security policy, Union Territory administration, disaster management, and general administration of MHA.
in-dept-home.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-dept-internal-security.name: Department of Internal Security
in-dept-internal-security.description: Handles internal security policy, Left-Wing Extremism, counter-terrorism coordination, Central Armed Police Forces deployment and modernisation.
in-dept-internal-security.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-dept-states.name: Department of States
in-dept-states.description: Centre-State relations, administration of Union Territories, freedom fighters' pension schemes and inter-governmental coordination on internal matters.
in-dept-states.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-dept-official-language.name: Department of Official Language
in-dept-official-language.description: Promotes and implements the use of Hindi as the Official Language of the Union under the Official Languages Act, 1963.
in-dept-official-language.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-dept-border-management.name: Department of Border Management
in-dept-border-management.description: Border infrastructure, border guarding forces' coordination, Integrated Check Posts and border area development programmes.
in-dept-border-management.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-dept-jammu-kashmir-and-ladakh-affairs.name: Department of Jammu, Kashmir and Ladakh Affairs
in-dept-jammu-kashmir-and-ladakh-affairs.description: Administers Union subjects concerning the Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh following the reorganisation under the J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019.
in-dept-jammu-kashmir-and-ladakh-affairs.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-ib.name: Intelligence Bureau
in-ib.description: India's internal intelligence agency; collects intelligence within India and conducts counter-intelligence and counter-terrorism duties. Not a statutory body.
in-ib.legalBasis: Executive order (no dedicated statute); functions administratively under MHA
in-ib.head: in-pos-director-ib

in-nia.name: National Investigation Agency
in-nia.description: India's federal counter-terrorism law-enforcement and investigation agency, empowered to probe terrorism and other scheduled offences across states without prior state consent.
in-nia.head: in-pos-dg-nia

in-ncb.name: Narcotics Control Bureau
in-ncb.description: Nodal drug law-enforcement agency responsible for fighting drug trafficking and abuse of illegal substances under the NDPS Act.
in-ncb.legalBasis: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 (NCB constituted 1986 under Section 4(3))
in-ncb.head: in-pos-dg-ncb

in-ncrb.name: National Crime Records Bureau
in-ncrb.description: Compiles and disseminates crime and criminal data for India, publishes the annual 'Crime in India' report, and runs the Crime and Criminal Tracking Network & Systems (CCTNS).
in-ncrb.legalBasis: Executive order (1986 Cabinet decision, no dedicated statute)
in-ncrb.head: in-pos-director-ncrb

in-bprd.name: Bureau of Police Research and Development
in-bprd.description: Apex research, training-standards and modernisation body for the Indian police, sets standards for CAPF/state police training, forensics and equipment.
in-bprd.head: in-pos-dg-bprd

in-bsf.name: Border Security Force
in-bsf.description: Primary border-guarding force for India's borders with Pakistan and Bangladesh; also deployed in counter-insurgency and internal security roles.
in-bsf.head: in-pos-dg-bsf

in-crpf.name: Central Reserve Police Force
in-crpf.description: India's largest CAPF; principal force for internal security duties, counter-insurgency, Left-Wing Extremism operations, election security and VIP security (less SPG).
in-crpf.head: in-pos-dg-crpf

in-cisf.name: Central Industrial Security Force
in-cisf.description: Provides security to critical infrastructure installations including airports, metro systems, nuclear and space establishments, and major PSUs.
in-cisf.head: in-pos-dg-cisf

in-itbp.name: Indo-Tibetan Border Police
in-itbp.description: Guards the Indo-China (Tibet) border in high-altitude terrain and performs disaster-response and VIP security duties.
in-itbp.head: in-pos-dg-itbp

in-ssb.name: Sashastra Seema Bal
in-ssb.description: Guards the Indo-Nepal and Indo-Bhutan borders and carries out border policing and counter-insurgency duties in the region.
in-ssb.head: in-pos-dg-ssb

in-assam-rifles.name: Assam Rifles
in-assam-rifles.description: India's oldest paramilitary force; guards the Indo-Myanmar border and conducts counter-insurgency operations in the North-East. Administratively under MHA, operationally under the Army.
in-assam-rifles.head: in-pos-dg-assam-rifles

in-nsg.name: National Security Guard
in-nsg.description: Federal contingency force specialising in counter-terrorism, hostage rescue and VIP protection ('Black Cats'); deployed on requisition for high-risk operations.
in-nsg.head: in-pos-dg-nsg

in-ndma.name: National Disaster Management Authority
in-ndma.description: Apex body for disaster management in India, laying down policies, plans and guidelines and coordinating their enforcement for prevention of and response to disasters.
in-ndma.head: in-pos-chairperson-ndma

holder.name: Krishna S. Vatsa
holder.notes: Listed by NDMA as 'Member & Head of the Department', effectively the senior-most full-time Member; no separate named Vice-Chairperson could be confirmed as of this research pass (position may be structurally vacant).

in-nidm.name: National Institute of Disaster Management
in-nidm.description: Apex training, research and capacity-building institute for disaster management, deemed to be a university.
in-nidm.head: in-pos-executive-director-nidm

in-ndrf.name: National Disaster Response Force
in-ndrf.description: Specialist force for response to natural and man-made disasters, including CBRN emergencies; drawn on deputation from CAPFs.
in-ndrf.head: in-pos-dg-ndrf

in-civil-defence.name: Directorate General, Civil Defence, Home Guards and Fire Services
in-civil-defence.description: Coordinates the civil defence, home guards and fire-service organisations that support disaster response and civil protection across states.
in-civil-defence.legalBasis: Civil Defence Act, 1968; Disaster Management Act, 2005 (fire services largely a state subject, coordinated centrally)

in-rgi.name: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
in-rgi.description: Conducts the decennial Census of India, maintains the Sample Registration System and civil registration (births/deaths) statistics, and administers the National Population Register.
in-rgi.legalBasis: Census Act, 1948; Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969
in-rgi.head: in-pos-rgi

in-census-2027.name: 2027 Census of India (16th Census)
in-census-2027.description: India's next decennial census, being conducted in two phases: House Listing and Housing Census (1 Apr-Sep 2026; Himalayan/snow-bound areas Oct 2025-Sep 2026) followed by Population Enumeration (9-28 Feb 2027, reference date 1 Mar 2027). Will include caste enumeration for the first time since 1931 and will be used for Lok Sabha delimitation and women's reservation implementation per the Delimitation Act, 2002.
in-census-2027.legalBasis: Census Act, 1948; Delimitation Act, 2002 (for downstream use of the data)

in-lpai.name: Land Ports Authority of India
in-lpai.description: Builds, upgrades and manages Integrated Check Posts (ICPs) at India's land borders to streamline cross-border trade and passenger movement.
in-lpai.legalBasis: Land Ports Authority of India Act, 2010
in-lpai.head: in-pos-chairman-lpai

in-boi.name: Bureau of Immigration
in-boi.description: Manages immigration control at India's international airports, seaports and land checkposts, foreigner registration (FRRO/FRO network) and immigration intelligence.
in-boi.legalBasis: Executive order under the Foreigners Act, 1946 / Passport (Entry into India) Act, 1920
in-boi.head: in-pos-commissioner-boi

in-svpnpa.name: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy
in-svpnpa.description: Trains newly-recruited IPS officers and conducts in-service police training programmes; India's premier police training institution.
in-svpnpa.established: 1948 (as CPTC, Mt Abu); moved to Hyderabad and renamed 1975
in-svpnpa.head: in-pos-director-svpnpa

in-i4c.name: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre
in-i4c.description: Coordinates action against cybercrime nationally, runs the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in) and the 1930 helpline, and hosts seven functional units including the Cyber and Multi-Agency Centre (CyMAC).
in-i4c.legalBasis: Scheme approved by Union Cabinet, October 2018 (Cyber and Information Security Division, MHA)

in-delhi-police.name: Delhi Police
in-delhi-police.description: Police force for the National Capital Territory of Delhi; unlike other city police forces, reports directly to the Union Government (MHA) rather than the Delhi state government.
in-delhi-police.established: 1861 (Delhi Police Act, 1978 gave the current statutory framework)
in-delhi-police.head: in-pos-commissioner-delhi-police

in-dfss.name: Directorate of Forensic Science Services
in-dfss.description: Apex forensic-science body coordinating the network of Central Forensic Science Laboratories (Delhi, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chandigarh, Guwahati, Bhopal, Pune) and setting forensic standards used by police and courts.

in-ncord.name: Narco-Coordination Centre
in-ncord.description: Multi-agency coordination mechanism (Centre, State and district levels) chaired by the Union Home Minister to strengthen anti-drug-trafficking coordination among central and state agencies.
in-ncord.head: in-pos-minister-home-affairs

in-cctns.name: Crime and Criminal Tracking Network & Systems
in-cctns.description: Nationwide networked IT system linking police stations to digitise FIR registration, investigation tracking and crime/criminal databases, operated by NCRB.
in-cctns.legalBasis: Union Cabinet-approved Mission Mode Project under the National e-Governance Plan

in-min-defence.name: Ministry of Defence
in-min-defence.description: Union ministry responsible for the defence of India and its armed forces: the Army, Navy, Air Force, Coast Guard, and all defence production and research bodies. Works through five departments.
in-min-defence.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-defence.head: in-pos-minister-defence

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Defence

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-defence.name: Department of Defence
in-dept-defence.description: The senior department of the Ministry of Defence; deals with policy for Defence and defence estates, cantonments, National Cadet Corps, Coast Guard and inter-service organisations, and coordinates the ministry as a whole.
in-dept-defence.head: in-pos-secretary-defence

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-military-affairs.name: Department of Military Affairs
in-dept-military-affairs.description: Created in 2020 to bring the Army, Navy and Air Force, and the Territorial Army under a single department; headed by the Chief of Defence Staff as ex-officio Secretary, and drives jointness/theaterisation and service-specific (non-capital) procurement.
in-dept-military-affairs.head: in-pos-cds

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-defence-production.name: Department of Defence Production
in-dept-defence-production.description: Handles indigenous production of defence equipment, oversight of the Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs) and Ordnance Factory successor companies, and defence exports/self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat) policy.
in-dept-defence-production.head: in-pos-secretary-defence-production

in-dept-defence-research-and-development.name: Department of Defence Research and Development
in-dept-defence-research-and-development.description: Runs India's defence research and development through DRDO; its Secretary is ex-officio Chairman of DRDO.
in-dept-defence-research-and-development.head: in-pos-secretary-ddrd-chairman-drdo

in-dept-ex-servicemen-welfare.name: Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare
in-dept-ex-servicemen-welfare.description: Deals with the welfare, resettlement and pension policy of ex-servicemen and their dependants, through bodies such as the Kendriya Sainik Board and the Directorate General of Resettlement.
in-dept-ex-servicemen-welfare.head: in-pos-secretary-ex-servicemen-welfare

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-army.name: Indian Army
in-army.description: India's land warfare service; the largest of the three armed forces, organised into seven operational/training Commands plus tri-service formations.
in-army.hq: Integrated Defence Staff HQ / Army HQ, New Delhi
in-army.head: in-pos-coas

in-navy.name: Indian Navy
in-navy.description: India's maritime warfare service, responsible for the Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal and wider Indian Ocean; organised into three Commands.
in-navy.head: in-pos-cns

in-iaf.name: Indian Air Force
in-iaf.description: India's aerial warfare service, organised into five operational and two functional (Training, Maintenance) Commands.
in-iaf.established: 1932-10-08 (as Royal Indian Air Force); current form since 1950-01-26
in-iaf.head: in-pos-cas

in-hq-ids.name: Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff
in-hq-ids.description: Tri-service planning and coordination staff supporting the Chief of Defence Staff/Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee; runs joint doctrine, force development, intelligence and administration for tri-service commands and agencies.
in-hq-ids.head: in-pos-cisc

in-andaman-nicobar-command.name: Andaman and Nicobar Command
in-andaman-nicobar-command.description: India's first tri-service unified command, guarding the Andaman & Nicobar Islands and the eastern approaches to the Malacca Strait.

in-strategic-forces-command.name: Strategic Forces Command
in-strategic-forces-command.description: Tri-service command that manages and administers India's strategic (nuclear-capable) missile and air assets under the Nuclear Command Authority.

in-defence-cyber-agency.name: Defence Cyber Agency
in-defence-cyber-agency.description: Tri-service agency for military cyber-security and cyber-warfare, drawing officers from the Army, Navy and Air Force.

in-defence-space-agency.name: Defence Space Agency
in-defence-space-agency.description: Tri-service agency responsible for operating space-related military assets and coordinating with ISRO on defence space needs.

in-defence-intelligence-agency.name: Defence Intelligence Agency
in-defence-intelligence-agency.description: India's primary military intelligence agency, coordinating intelligence for and from the three Services and tasking tri-service assets such as the Defence Image Processing and Analysis Centre.

in-territorial-army.name: Territorial Army
in-territorial-army.description: A volunteer reserve force that supports the regular Army, mostly with part-time citizen soldiers who retain civilian jobs.

in-army-northern-command.name: Northern Command
in-army-northern-command.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Udhampur.
in-army-northern-command.head: in-pos-goc-in-c-northern-command

in-army-western-command.name: Western Command
in-army-western-command.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Chandimandir.
in-army-western-command.head: in-pos-goc-in-c-western-command

in-army-eastern-command.name: Eastern Command
in-army-eastern-command.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Kolkata.
in-army-eastern-command.head: in-pos-goc-in-c-eastern-command

in-army-southern-command.name: Southern Command
in-army-southern-command.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Pune.
in-army-southern-command.head: in-pos-goc-in-c-southern-command

in-army-south-western-command.name: South Western Command
in-army-south-western-command.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Jaipur.
in-army-south-western-command.head: in-pos-goc-in-c-south-western-command

in-army-central-command.name: Central Command
in-army-central-command.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Lucknow.
in-army-central-command.head: in-pos-goc-in-c-central-command

in-army-training-command.name: Army Training Command (ARTRAC)
in-army-training-command.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Shimla.
in-army-training-command.head: in-pos-goc-in-c-artrac

in-navy-western-naval-command.name: Western Naval Command
in-navy-western-naval-command.description: One of the Indian Navy's three area commands, headquartered at Mumbai.
in-navy-western-naval-command.head: in-pos-foc-in-c-western-naval-command

in-navy-eastern-naval-command.name: Eastern Naval Command
in-navy-eastern-naval-command.description: One of the Indian Navy's three area commands, headquartered at Visakhapatnam.
in-navy-eastern-naval-command.head: in-pos-foc-in-c-eastern-naval-command

in-navy-southern-naval-command.name: Southern Naval Command
in-navy-southern-naval-command.description: One of the Indian Navy's three area commands, headquartered at Kochi.
in-navy-southern-naval-command.head: in-pos-foc-in-c-southern-naval-command

in-iaf-western-air-command.name: Western Air Command
in-iaf-western-air-command.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at New Delhi.
in-iaf-western-air-command.head: in-pos-aoc-in-c-western-air-command

in-iaf-eastern-air-command.name: Eastern Air Command
in-iaf-eastern-air-command.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at Shillong.
in-iaf-eastern-air-command.head: in-pos-aoc-in-c-eastern-air-command

in-iaf-central-air-command.name: Central Air Command
in-iaf-central-air-command.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at Prayagraj.
in-iaf-central-air-command.head: in-pos-aoc-in-c-central-air-command

in-iaf-southern-air-command.name: Southern Air Command
in-iaf-southern-air-command.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at Thiruvananthapuram.
in-iaf-southern-air-command.head: in-pos-aoc-in-c-southern-air-command

in-iaf-south-western-air-command.name: South Western Air Command
in-iaf-south-western-air-command.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at Gandhinagar.
in-iaf-south-western-air-command.head: in-pos-aoc-in-c-south-western-air-command

in-iaf-training-command.name: Training Command
in-iaf-training-command.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at Bengaluru.
in-iaf-training-command.head: in-pos-aoc-in-c-training-command

in-iaf-maintenance-command.name: Maintenance Command
in-iaf-maintenance-command.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at Nagpur.
in-iaf-maintenance-command.head: in-pos-aoc-in-c-maintenance-command

in-coast-guard.name: Indian Coast Guard
in-coast-guard.description: Multi-mission maritime force responsible for coastal and offshore security, search-and-rescue, marine environment protection and anti-smuggling in Indian waters; distinct from the Navy, under the Ministry of Defence.
in-coast-guard.head: in-pos-dg-coast-guard

in-bro.name: Border Roads Organisation
in-bro.description: Builds and maintains roads, bridges, airfields and other infrastructure in India's border regions, mostly through the General Reserve Engineer Force (GREF), for both military and civilian use.
in-bro.head: in-pos-dg-bro

in-dgde.name: Directorate General Defence Estates
in-dgde.description: Manages defence land and cantonments across India, and administers the network of Cantonment Boards.

in-cantonment-boards.name: Cantonment Boards
in-cantonment-boards.description: Aggregate of India's Defence-administered local self-government bodies for military garrison towns (cantonments); civic administration in many cantonments is being progressively handed over to neighbouring municipalities since 2024, shrinking the count.

in-drdo.name: Defence Research and Development Organisation
in-drdo.description: India's central defence R&D agency; designs and develops missiles, aircraft avionics, armaments, radars, electronic-warfare systems and other military technology through a network of laboratories organised into technology clusters.
in-drdo.head: in-pos-secretary-ddrd-chairman-drdo

in-drdo-cluster-aero.name: Aeronautical Systems Cluster
in-drdo-cluster-aero.description: Unmanned air vehicles, aero gas-turbine engines and airborne surveillance systems.

in-drdo-cluster-ecs.name: Electronics & Communication Systems Cluster
in-drdo-cluster-ecs.description: Electronic, electro-optical and laser-based sensors, radars and communication systems.

in-drdo-cluster-mcc.name: Micro Electronic Devices, Computational Systems & Cyber Security Cluster

in-drdo-cluster-mss.name: Missiles & Strategic Systems Cluster
in-drdo-cluster-mss.description: Missile and strategic-systems development (e.g. Agni, Akash, BrahMos-linked work).

in-drdo-cluster-nsm.name: Naval Systems & Materials Cluster
in-drdo-cluster-nsm.description: Six naval laboratories including NPOL and NSTL, plus materials research.

in-drdo-cluster-sss.name: Soldier Support Systems Cluster
in-drdo-cluster-sss.description: Soldier equipment, life sciences and high-altitude/extreme-environment support.

in-mes.name: Military Engineer Services
in-mes.description: Inter-service engineering organisation that builds and maintains infrastructure (barracks, airfields, hospitals, roads, dockyards) for the Army, Navy and Air Force, combining military Engineer officers with civilian engineering cadres.
in-mes.head: in-pos-engineer-in-chief-mes

in-afms.name: Armed Forces Medical Services
in-afms.description: Tri-service medical corps providing healthcare to the Army, Navy and Air Force and their families, including battlefield medicine and military hospitals.
in-afms.head: in-pos-dgafms

in-afmc.name: Armed Forces Medical College
in-afmc.description: Premier tri-service medical training institution, established 1948, that trains doctors and nurses for the Armed Forces Medical Services.

in-dad.name: Defence Accounts Department
in-dad.description: Financial-advice, payment and accounting organisation for the Ministry of Defence and armed forces, headed by the Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA), who is the Principal Accounting Officer for defence expenditure.
in-dad.head: in-pos-cgda

in-ncc.name: National Cadet Corps
in-ncc.description: Tri-service youth voluntary organisation that gives school and college students basic military training and a sense of discipline and national service; not a reserve of the armed forces.
in-ncc.head: in-pos-dg-ncc

in-sainik-schools-society.name: Sainik Schools Society
in-sainik-schools-society.description: Registered society under the Ministry of Defence that runs the Sainik Schools network (co-run with state governments), preparing students for entry to the National Defence Academy and other officer-training institutes.

in-nda.name: National Defence Academy
in-nda.description: Tri-service pre-commissioning training academy for cadets of the Army, Navy and Air Force before they proceed to their respective service academies.

in-ima.name: Indian Military Academy
in-ima.description: Premier officer-training academy of the Indian Army, commissioning permanent-commission officers into the Army.

in-dssc.name: Defence Services Staff College
in-dssc.description: Tri-service staff college that trains mid-career officers of the Army, Navy, Air Force and friendly foreign militaries in staff duties and joint operations.

in-national-defence-college.name: National Defence College
in-national-defence-college.description: India's highest seat of strategic studies, training senior defence-service and civil-service officers (and friendly foreign officers) for top-level strategic leadership roles.

in-idsa.name: Manohar Parrikar Institute for Defence Studies and Analyses
in-idsa.description: Government-funded autonomous think tank conducting research on strategic, defence and security affairs and training civilian, military and police officers.

in-ksb.name: Kendriya Sainik Board
in-ksb.description: Apex central body (with State/District Sainik Boards under it) for welfare and resettlement of ex-servicemen, war widows and their dependants.

in-dgr.name: Directorate General of Resettlement
in-dgr.description: Runs resettlement, re-employment training and placement programmes for retiring and retired defence personnel.

in-echs.name: Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme Organisation
in-echs.description: Runs the contributory health scheme providing medical care to ex-servicemen pensioners and their dependants through polyclinics and empanelled hospitals.

in-hal.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited
in-hal.description: Aerospace and defence PSU designing, manufacturing and overhauling combat aircraft, helicopters, UAVs, engines and avionics; Maharatna status (Oct 2024).

in-bel.name: Bharat Electronics Limited
in-bel.description: Defence electronics and aerospace PSU making radars, communication systems, missile electronics, naval systems and avionics; Navratna status.

in-bdl.name: Bharat Dynamics Limited
in-bdl.description: Prime production agency for India's guided-missile programmes (Akash, Prithvi variants, anti-tank guided missiles, torpedoes) built in partnership with DRDO.

in-beml.name: BEML Limited
in-beml.description: Heavy-equipment PSU (earthmoving, rail & metro, defence & aerospace); historically a defence PSU, now administratively a multi-ministry enterprise with close defence-production ties. Government holding ~54%.

in-mdl.name: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited
in-mdl.description: India's premier warship and submarine builder for the Indian Navy (destroyers, frigates, corvettes, diesel-electric submarines); Navratna status.

in-grse.name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited
in-grse.description: Kolkata-based defence shipyard building and repairing naval and commercial vessels; granted Navratna status June 2026.

in-gsl.name: Goa Shipyard Limited
in-gsl.description: Builds frigates, offshore patrol vessels and patrol boats for the Navy and Coast Guard; capacity limited to vessels under 15,000 DWT.

in-hsl.name: Hindustan Shipyard Limited
in-hsl.description: India's second-largest shipyard; ship building/repair and submarine construction and refits; transferred from the Ministry of Shipping to the Ministry of Defence in 2010.

in-midhani.name: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited
in-midhani.description: Manufactures superalloys, titanium and special steels for aerospace, defence and atomic-energy use, including materials for Chandrayaan-3 and Gaganyaan.

in-aweil.name: Advanced Weapons and Equipment India Limited
in-aweil.description: Ordnance Factory Board successor company (est. 2021) making field guns, gun carriages, small arms and artillery; runs the former Field Gun, Gun Carriage, Gun & Shell, Rifle and Small Arms Factories.

in-avnl.name: Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited
in-avnl.description: Ordnance Factory Board successor company making tanks, armoured vehicles and tank engines; runs the former Heavy Vehicles Factory, Engine Factory Avadi, Vehicle Factory Jabalpur and Ordnance Factory Medak.
in-avnl.head: in-pos-cmd-avnl

in-mil.name: Munitions India Limited
in-mil.description: Ordnance Factory Board successor company making ammunition, explosives, propellants and cordite; runs the former Ammunition Factory Khadki and Cordite Factory Aruvankadu among others.

in-yil.name: Yantra India Limited
in-yil.description: Ordnance Factory Board successor company making machine tools, metal/steel components and foundry items; runs former Metal & Steel Factory and Grey Iron Foundry sites.

in-iol.name: India Optel Limited
in-iol.description: Ordnance Factory Board successor company making optoelectronic devices and precision optical instruments; runs the former Opto Electronics Factory Dehradun.

in-gil.name: Gliders India Limited
in-gil.description: Smallest Ordnance Factory Board successor company, making parachutes and related aircrew support equipment, from the former Ordnance Parachute Factory Kanpur.

in-tcl.name: Troop Comforts Limited
in-tcl.description: Ordnance Factory Board successor company making military uniforms, clothing and combat gear; runs the former Ordnance Clothing and Ordnance Equipment Factories.

in-min-external-affairs.name: Ministry of External Affairs
in-min-external-affairs.description: Conducts India's foreign relations and diplomacy, runs India's missions abroad, negotiates treaties, and delivers consular, passport and visa services to citizens and the diaspora.
in-min-external-affairs.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-external-affairs.head: in-pos-minister-external-affairs

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of External Affairs
Minister of State in the Ministry of External Affairs

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-cpv-division.name: Consular, Passport, Visa and Overseas Indian Affairs (CPV) Division
in-cpv-division.description: Issues Indian passports and visas, handles consular protection of citizens abroad and overseas Indian affairs, delivered nationwide through Passport Seva Kendras under the Passport Seva Programme (a public-private partnership launched 2010).

in-office-of-protector-general-of-emigra.name: Office of the Protector General of Emigrants
in-office-of-protector-general-of-emigra.description: Regulates and grants emigration clearance for Indian workers going to notified (ECR) countries, and oversees the network of Protectors of Emigrants at major cities/airports, to protect migrant workers from exploitation.

in-iccr.name: Indian Council for Cultural Relations
in-iccr.description: India's cultural diplomacy body: runs cultural centres abroad, funds scholarships for foreign students in India, sponsors cultural exchange and artiste tours to project India's soft power.
in-iccr.legalBasis: Registered society; functions under MEA administrative control
in-iccr.head: in-pos-president-iccr

in-icwa.name: Indian Council of World Affairs
in-icwa.description: India's oldest foreign-policy think tank; conducts research, dialogues and publications on international relations and is declared an Institution of National Importance.
in-icwa.legalBasis: Indian Council of World Affairs Act, 2001
in-icwa.hq: Sapru House, Barakhamba Road, New Delhi
in-icwa.head: in-pos-president-icwa

in-ris.name: Research and Information System for Developing Countries
in-ris.description: An MEA-funded autonomous policy-research think tank on international economic issues, South-South cooperation, trade and development for developing countries.

in-nalanda-university.name: Nalanda University
in-nalanda-university.description: An international postgraduate research university at Rajgir, Bihar, revived as a symbol of India's civilisational links to Asia; supported by member countries of the East Asia Summit, with the President of India as Visitor.
in-nalanda-university.head: in-pos-chancellor-nalanda

in-ssifs.name: Sushma Swaraj Institute of Foreign Service
in-ssifs.description: Trains newly recruited Indian Foreign Service officers and runs induction/mid-career diplomatic training courses; renamed in 2020 for former EAM Sushma Swaraj.

in-itec-programme.name: Indian Technical and Economic Cooperation Programme
in-itec-programme.description: India's flagship international capacity-building and development-partnership programme, offering training slots, projects, consultancy and disaster relief to partner developing countries since 1964.
in-itec-programme.head: in-pos-secretary-mea-er

in-indian-missions-abroad.name: Indian Diplomatic Missions Abroad (aggregate)
in-indian-missions-abroad.description: Aggregate entity representing India's network of resident embassies, high commissions, permanent missions and consulates abroad, each headed by an Ambassador/High Commissioner reporting to MEA.
in-indian-missions-abroad.legalBasis: Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, 1961 (domestic implementation via MEA)

in-min-law-and-justice.name: Ministry of Law and Justice
in-min-law-and-justice.description: Manages India's legal affairs, drafts central legislation, administers the justice-delivery system, and advises other ministries on law, through three departments: Legal Affairs, Legislative, and Justice.
in-min-law-and-justice.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-law-and-justice.head: in-pos-minister-law-justice

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-legal-affairs.name: Department of Legal Affairs
in-dept-legal-affairs.description: Advises ministries on legal questions, drafts contracts and treaties, and superintends the offices of the Attorney General, Solicitor General and government law officers.
in-dept-legal-affairs.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-dept-legislative.name: Legislative Department
in-dept-legislative.description: Drafts principal central legislation (Bills and major subordinate legislation), and administers the Official Languages Act translation of central Acts and Rules into Hindi.
in-dept-legislative.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-official-language-wing-legislative.name: Official Language Wing, Legislative Department
in-official-language-wing-legislative.description: Translates central Acts, Ordinances and statutory rules/orders into Hindi (the authoritative Hindi text) and maintains the standard legal-Hindi lexicon used across government.

in-dept-justice.name: Department of Justice
in-dept-justice.description: Administers judicial infrastructure funding, judges' appointments processing, and centrally sponsored schemes to speed up justice delivery (e-Courts, fast-track courts, legal aid support).
in-dept-justice.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; separated from Ministry of Home Affairs, 1 January 2010

in-national-mission-justice-delivery-leg.name: National Mission for Justice Delivery and Legal Reforms
in-national-mission-justice-delivery-leg.description: Department of Justice mission to reduce case pendency and delays by improving judicial infrastructure, human resources and case/court management, and by focusing on vulnerable litigants.
in-national-mission-justice-delivery-leg.head: in-pos-secretary-justice

in-ecourts-mission-mode-project.name: eCourts Mission Mode Project
in-ecourts-mission-mode-project.description: Department of Justice-funded ICT-enablement of India's district and subordinate courts (case information systems, e-filing, video-conferencing), implemented in coordination with the e-Committee of the Supreme Court.
in-ecourts-mission-mode-project.legalBasis: National Policy and Action Plan for ICT Implementation in the Indian Judiciary (2005)
in-ecourts-mission-mode-project.head: in-pos-secretary-justice

in-law-commission-of-india.name: Law Commission of India (23rd)
in-law-commission-of-india.description: Government-appointed expert body that reviews and recommends reform of Indian laws; the 23rd Commission was constituted for a three-year term to examine matters referred by the government.
in-law-commission-of-india.legalBasis: Government of India Resolution constituting the 23rd Law Commission
in-law-commission-of-india.head: in-pos-chair-law-commission

in-national-judicial-academy.name: National Judicial Academy
in-national-judicial-academy.description: Trains judges, court staff and other justice-system stakeholders and conducts research on judicial administration; governed by a Council chaired by the Chief Justice of India, funded via the Department of Justice.
in-national-judicial-academy.legalBasis: Registered society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860

in-bar-council-of-india.name: Bar Council of India
in-bar-council-of-india.description: Statutory self-regulatory body for the legal profession: sets standards for legal education, enrols and disciplines advocates, and lays down professional conduct rules across India.
in-bar-council-of-india.head: in-pos-chairman-bci

in-indian-law-institute.name: Indian Law Institute
in-indian-law-institute.description: Deemed-university socio-legal research and training institute opposite the Supreme Court; publishes the Journal of the Indian Law Institute and runs postgraduate law programmes.
in-indian-law-institute.legalBasis: Registered society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860; deemed university under UGC Act, 1956
in-indian-law-institute.head: in-pos-president-ili

in-min-personnel-public-grievances-and-p.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
in-min-personnel-public-grievances-and-p.description: Runs the Union's civil-service HR system (recruitment policy, IAS/central-service cadre management, training, vigilance-linked appointments), public-grievance redress, administrative reform, and pension policy for central government employees, through three departments.
in-min-personnel-public-grievances-and-p.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-personnel-public-grievances-and-p.head: in-pos-minister-personnel

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
Minister of State, Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions

holder.name: Jitendra Singh
holder.notes: Also MoS (IC) Science & Technology and Earth Sciences, and MoS in PMO.

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-personnel-and-training.name: Department of Personnel and Training
in-dept-personnel-and-training.description: The Union government's central personnel agency: sets civil-service recruitment, promotion, training, service-conduct and cadre-management rules for the IAS and central civil services, and oversees the CBI.
in-dept-personnel-and-training.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-dept-administrative-reforms-and-publi.name: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances
in-dept-administrative-reforms-and-publi.description: Drives administrative-reform policy (e-governance, Sevottam service standards) and runs the Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) for citizen complaints against government.
in-dept-administrative-reforms-and-publi.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

in-dept-pension-and-pensioners-welfare.name: Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare
in-dept-pension-and-pensioners-welfare.description: Frames pension policy for central government civil pensioners (including the National Pension System's rules for government employees) and handles pensioner grievances.
in-dept-pension-and-pensioners-welfare.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-cbi.name: Central Bureau of Investigation
in-cbi.description: India's premier federal investigative agency, probing corruption by central government officials, major frauds/economic offences, and serious/inter-state crimes referred by courts or state consent.
in-cbi.head: in-pos-director-cbi

in-lbsnaa.name: Lal Bahadur Shastri National Academy of Administration
in-lbsnaa.description: The all-India foundation-course and induction-training academy for the IAS and allied civil services, at Mussoorie.

in-istm.name: Institute of Secretariat Training and Management
in-istm.description: Central training institute for Union government employees: orientation, financial management, behavioural and secretariat-procedure courses, plus consultancy.

in-staff-selection-commission.name: Staff Selection Commission
in-staff-selection-commission.description: Recruits staff for Group B and Group C (non-technical) posts in Union government ministries, departments and subordinate offices through nationwide competitive examinations.
in-staff-selection-commission.legalBasis: Government of India Resolution constituting the SSC (1975/1977)
in-staff-selection-commission.head: in-pos-chairman-ssc

in-karmayogi-bharat.name: Mission Karmayogi (Karmayogi Bharat)
in-karmayogi-bharat.description: National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building: a competency-based, technology-enabled civil-service training reform run through the iGOT Karmayogi digital learning platform and delivered by the not-for-profit Karmayogi Bharat SPV.

in-capacity-building-commission.name: Capacity Building Commission
in-capacity-building-commission.description: Oversees and harmonises civil-service training institutions and curricula government-wide under Mission Karmayogi, and advises DoPT on capacity-building policy.
in-capacity-building-commission.head: in-pos-chairperson-cbc

in-ncgg.name: National Centre for Good Governance
in-ncgg.description: Trains Indian and partner-country (e.g. Bangladesh, Maldives, Bhutan, other developing nations) civil servants in governance reform, e-governance and public policy under DARPG's administrative oversight.
in-ncgg.head: in-pos-secretary-darpg

in-iipa.name: Indian Institute of Public Administration
in-iipa.description: Autonomous research and training body for public administration; trains civil servants and publishes the Indian Journal of Public Administration.
in-iipa.head: in-pos-president-iipa

in-min-parliamentary-affairs.name: Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs
in-min-parliamentary-affairs.description: Coordinates government business in Parliament: schedules sessions in consultation with the presiding officers, tracks legislative business, follows up on assurances given by ministers on the floor of the House, and liaises between the government and the Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha secretariats.
in-min-parliamentary-affairs.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-parliamentary-affairs.head: in-pos-minister-parliamentary-affairs

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs
Minister of State in the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-min-cooperation.name: Ministry of Cooperation
in-min-cooperation.description: Provides a separate administrative, legal and policy framework to strengthen India's cooperative movement (credit, dairy, sugar, fertiliser, housing, marketing and export cooperatives), a subject that is otherwise primarily state-level.
in-min-cooperation.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-cooperation.head: in-pos-minister-cooperation

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Co-operation
Minister of State in the Ministry of Co-operation

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-crcs.name: Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies
in-crcs.description: Registers and regulates Multi-State Cooperative Societies (societies whose objects/operations span more than one state), including approving their bye-laws, amalgamations and winding-up.

in-ncdc.name: National Cooperative Development Corporation
in-ncdc.description: Statutory corporation that plans and finances programmes for the production, processing, marketing, storage, export and import of agricultural produce, foodstuffs and other cooperative-sector goods.
in-ncdc.head: in-pos-md-ncdc

in-ncel.name: National Cooperative Exports Limited
in-ncel.description: Multi-state apex cooperative society to aggregate and export cooperative-sector produce (agri-commodities, handicrafts and more) on behalf of member cooperatives, aiming to boost farmer/cooperative incomes via exports.

in-ncol.name: National Cooperative Organics Limited
in-ncol.description: Multi-state apex cooperative society to produce, certify and market organic products (branded 'Bharat Organics') to give farmers a structured, unadulterated-organic supply chain and better prices.

in-bbssl.name: Bhartiya Beej Sahkari Samiti Limited
in-bbssl.description: National multi-state cooperative seed society to produce, procure and market quality/certified seeds through cooperatives, reducing farmer dependence on private seed supply.

in-tribhuvan-sahkari-university.name: Tribhuvan Sahkari University
in-tribhuvan-sahkari-university.description: India's first cooperative university (formerly the Institute of Rural Management Anand, IRMA), redesignated by Act of Parliament to train professional managers for cooperatives and rural producer organisations.
in-tribhuvan-sahkari-university.head: in-pos-vc-tsu

in-passport-seva-programme.name: Passport Seva Programme
in-passport-seva-programme.description: MEA's flagship e-governance programme (run in public-private partnership) that digitised and decentralised passport issuance through a national network of Passport Seva Kendras and Post Office Passport Seva Kendras, under the CPV Division.

in-min-railways.name: Ministry of Railways
in-min-railways.description: Runs Indian Railways, one of the world's largest rail networks, through the Railway Board, which functions as both the ministry's executive board and its administrative apex; owns 18 zonal railways, production units, and a cluster of railway PSUs.
in-min-railways.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Railways Act, 1989
in-min-railways.head: in-pos-minister-railways

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Railways
Minister of State in the Ministry of Railways

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-rpf.name: Railway Protection Force
in-rpf.description: Statutory security force of the Ministry of Railways responsible for protecting railway property, passenger area and passengers; has powers of arrest and investigation for railway-related offences.
in-rpf.head: in-pos-dg-rpf

in-rdso.name: Research Designs and Standards Organisation
in-rdso.description: Railway Board's principal R&D arm, headquartered in Lucknow; sets technical standards, tests and approves rolling stock, signalling and civil engineering designs for Indian Railways.
in-rdso.head: in-pos-dg-rdso

in-central-railway.name: Central Railway
in-central-railway.description: One of the 18 operating zones of Indian Railways, headquartered at Mumbai CSMT; runs train operations, infrastructure and commercial functions for its constituent divisions.
in-central-railway.head: in-pos-gm-central-railway

in-eastern-railway.name: Eastern Railway
in-eastern-railway.description: One of the 18 operating zones of Indian Railways, headquartered at Kolkata; runs train operations, infrastructure and commercial functions for its constituent divisions.
in-eastern-railway.head: in-pos-gm-eastern-railway

in-east-central-railway.name: East Central Railway
in-east-central-railway.description: One of the 18 operating zones of Indian Railways, headquartered at Hajipur; runs train operations, infrastructure and commercial functions for its constituent divisions.
in-east-central-railway.head: in-pos-gm-east-central-railway

in-east-coast-railway.name: East Coast Railway
in-east-coast-railway.description: One of the 18 operating zones of Indian Railways, headquartered at Bhubaneswar; runs train operations, infrastructure and commercial functions for its constituent divisions.
in-east-coast-railway.head: in-pos-gm-east-coast-railway

in-metro-railway-kolkata.name: Metro Railway, Kolkata
in-metro-railway-kolkata.description: One of the 18 operating zones of Indian Railways, headquartered at Kolkata; runs train operations, infrastructure and commercial functions for its constituent divisions.
in-metro-railway-kolkata.head: in-pos-gm-metro-railway-kolkata

in-northern-railway.name: Northern Railway
in-northern-railway.description: One of the 18 operating zones of Indian Railways, headquartered at Delhi; runs train operations, infrastructure and commercial functions for its constituent divisions.
