in-min-communications.head: in-pos-minister-communications

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Communications

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-telecommunications.name: Department of Telecommunications
in-dept-telecommunications.description: Regulates telecom licensing, spectrum allocation/pricing, and oversees BSNL/MTNL and the telecom PSU/R&D ecosystem; secretariat for the (now-dissolved) Digital Communications Commission.
in-dept-telecommunications.head: in-pos-secretary-telecommunications

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-digital-communications-commission.name: Digital Communications Commission
in-digital-communications-commission.description: DISSOLVED. Formerly the apex inter-departmental decision-making body of DoT (est. 1989 as the Telecom Commission, renamed 2018); held its final meeting 3 September 2026 on satellite-spectrum policy and was dissolved with effect from 19 September 2026, with its approval functions transferred to the Telecom Secretary, the Minister, or an Expenditure Finance Committee depending on the value involved.

in-bsnl.name: Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited
in-bsnl.description: State-owned telecom operator providing mobile, landline, broadband and enterprise services nationwide; undergoing 4G/5G revival funded by successive government equity infusions.
in-bsnl.head: in-pos-head-bsnl

in-mtnl.name: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited
in-mtnl.description: State-owned telecom operator for Mumbai and Delhi circles; now run under common management with BSNL as part of its revival/merger process.
in-mtnl.head: in-pos-head-mtnl

in-bbnl.name: Bharat Broadband Network Limited
in-bbnl.description: DEFUNCT. Built India's National Optical Fibre Network (BharatNet) to villages/gram panchayats; merged into BSNL after a Cabinet decision of 27 July 2022 (merger completed later that year).

in-cdot.name: Centre for Development of Telematics
in-cdot.description: Government-owned telecom-technology R&D centre that designs indigenous telecom/networking equipment (e.g. 4G/5G core, GPON) for Indian operators including BSNL.
in-cdot.head: in-pos-head-cdot

in-tec.name: Telecommunication Engineering Centre
in-tec.description: DoT's technical standards body: sets Generic Requirements and Interface Requirements for telecom equipment and coordinates testing/certification standards.

in-dept-posts.name: Department of Posts
in-dept-posts.description: Runs India Post, the country's postal service and (via its Postal Services Board) sets postal policy; operates the world's most extensive post-office network and India Post Payments Bank.
in-dept-posts.hq: Dak Bhawan, Sansad Marg, New Delhi
in-dept-posts.head: in-pos-secretary-posts

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-postal-services-board.name: Postal Services Board
in-postal-services-board.description: Apex decision-making board of the Department of Posts, chaired ex officio by the Secretary (Posts), with Members for operations, personnel, technology and banking.

in-ippb.name: India Post Payments Bank
in-ippb.description: Payments bank wholly owned by the Department of Posts, using the postal network (including postmen/Grameen Dak Sevaks) to deliver banking and financial-inclusion services.
in-ippb.head: in-pos-head-ippb

in-rlda.name: Rail Land Development Authority
in-rlda.description: Statutory authority that commercially develops vacant railway land and redevelops railway stations (e.g. New Delhi, Bhopal); absorbed the Indian Railway Stations Development Corporation (IRSDC) in 2022.
in-rlda.head: in-pos-head-rlda

in-core.name: Central Organisation for Railway Electrification
in-core.description: Railway Board's specialised organisation executing electrification of railway routes across all zones.
in-core.head: in-pos-head-core

in-bharatmala-pariyojana.name: Bharatmala Pariyojana
in-bharatmala-pariyojana.description: Umbrella national highway-development programme (launched 2017) for economic corridors, inter-corridor/feeder roads, border and coastal roads, and port connectivity, implemented mainly through NHAI.

in-udan-rcs.name: UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) - Regional Connectivity Scheme
in-udan-rcs.description: Regional Connectivity Scheme (launched 2016) subsidising airlines to fly under-served and unserved routes/airports to make air travel affordable, via viability-gap funding.

in-sagarmala.name: Sagarmala Programme
in-sagarmala.description: Flagship port-led development programme (launched 2015) for port modernisation, port connectivity, port-linked industrialisation and coastal community development.

in-dept-capital-development.name: Department of Capital Development
in-dept-capital-development.description: Carved out of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs in July 2026 to run local capital governance for the National Capital Region, separating it from broader national urban-policy functions.
in-dept-capital-development.head: in-pos-secretary-capital-development
in-dept-capital-development.notes: Found during adversarial re-verification (2026-09-25); MISSING from the original ministries-c segment. Only one source located (Wikipedia infobox/prose, no gazette notification or PIB release found in the time available) — confirm against the Allocation of Business Rules / a gazette notification before publish.

in-min-power.name: Ministry of Power
in-min-power.description: Formulates national policy on generation, transmission and distribution of electricity, drives rural electrification and grid modernisation, and administers India's central power-sector PSUs and the electricity regulator's parent framework.
in-min-power.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Electricity Act, 2003
in-min-power.head: in-pos-minister-power

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Power

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-cea.name: Central Electricity Authority
in-cea.description: Statutory technical authority under the Electricity Act, 2003 that specifies technical standards, prepares the National Electricity Plan and advises the Union government on power-sector planning; distinct from the tariff regulator CERC.
in-cea.head: in-pos-chairperson-cea

in-bee.name: Bureau of Energy Efficiency
in-bee.description: Statutory body that drives energy-efficiency policy — star-labelling of appliances, PAT (Perform-Achieve-Trade) scheme for industry, and building energy codes — under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001.
in-bee.head: in-pos-director-general-bee

in-ntpc.name: NTPC Limited
in-ntpc.description: India's largest power generation company, a Maharatna CPSE that runs coal, gas, hydro, nuclear-JV and renewable power plants and is the anchor of India's thermal generation capacity.
in-ntpc.head: in-pos-chair-ntpc

in-pgcil.name: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
in-pgcil.description: Central Transmission Utility that owns and operates over 85% of India's inter-state electricity transmission network; a Maharatna CPSE.
in-pgcil.head: in-pos-chair-pgcil

in-nhpc.name: NHPC Limited
in-nhpc.description: India's largest hydropower generation company, a Mini-Ratna-turned-Schedule-A CPSE that builds and operates hydroelectric and some renewable-energy projects across the Himalayan and north-eastern river basins.
in-nhpc.head: in-pos-chair-nhpc

in-pfc.name: Power Finance Corporation Limited
in-pfc.description: Systemically important NBFC and Maharatna CPSE that is India's largest lender to the power sector, financing generation, transmission and distribution projects; parent of REC Limited.
in-pfc.head: in-pos-chair-pfc

in-rec-limited.name: REC Limited
in-rec-limited.description: NBFC financing power, infrastructure and logistics projects, formerly Rural Electrification Corporation; now a subsidiary of Power Finance Corporation and slated for merger into PFC.
in-rec-limited.head: in-pos-chair-rec-limited

in-sjvn.name: SJVN Limited
in-sjvn.description: Hydro and renewable power generation CPSE jointly owned by the Union government (59.92%) and the Government of Himachal Pradesh (26.85%), originally built to develop the Sutlej basin.
in-sjvn.head: in-pos-chair-sjvn

in-thdc-india.name: THDC India Limited
in-thdc-india.description: Hydropower CPSE (originally Tehri Hydro Development Corporation) that built and runs the Tehri dam complex; jointly owned by the Union government and Uttar Pradesh, administratively a subsidiary of NTPC.
in-thdc-india.head: in-pos-chair-thdc-india

in-neepco.name: North Eastern Electric Power Corporation Limited
in-neepco.description: Hydro and thermal power generation CPSE dedicated to developing power projects across the north-eastern states; a subsidiary of NTPC.
in-neepco.head: in-pos-chair-neepco

in-dvc.name: Damodar Valley Corporation
in-dvc.description: India's first multi-purpose river-valley statutory authority (on the TVA model), generating and distributing power and managing flood control/irrigation across the Damodar basin in Jharkhand and West Bengal.
in-dvc.head: in-pos-chair-dvc

in-grid-india.name: Grid Controller of India Limited
in-grid-india.description: Operates India's national and regional power grids as the country's Independent System Operator, formerly the Power System Operation Corporation (POSOCO); a wholly government-owned entity.
in-grid-india.head: in-pos-chair-grid-india

in-npti.name: National Power Training Institute
in-npti.description: Apex training and human-resource-development institute for India's power sector, running specialised training centres across the country under the Ministry of Power.

in-eesl.name: Energy Efficiency Services Limited
in-eesl.description: Joint-venture CPSE of PSUs under the Ministry of Power that implements India's LED bulb (UJALA) and other energy-efficiency market-transformation programmes.

in-min-new-and-renewable-energy.name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
in-min-new-and-renewable-energy.description: Nodal ministry for solar, wind, bio-energy, small-hydro and green-hydrogen policy, driving India's renewable-capacity targets and schemes such as PM Surya Ghar and the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
in-min-new-and-renewable-energy.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-new-and-renewable-energy.head: in-pos-minister-new-and-renewable-energy

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-seci.name: Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited
in-seci.description: Central nodal agency for implementing India's solar (and increasingly wind, hybrid and green-hydrogen) tenders and power-purchase agreements on behalf of the government.
in-seci.head: in-pos-chairman-seci

in-ireda.name: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited
in-ireda.description: NBFC CPSE (listed, Navratna-track) that provides project finance for renewable-energy and energy-efficiency ventures; the principal financing arm of MNRE.
in-ireda.head: in-pos-chair-ireda

in-nise.name: National Institute of Solar Energy
in-nise.description: MNRE's apex autonomous research, testing and training institute for solar-energy technologies, based in Gurugram.

in-niwe.name: National Institute of Wind Energy
in-niwe.description: MNRE's autonomous institute for wind-resource assessment, testing/certification of wind turbines and wind-energy R&D, based in Chennai.

in-sss-nibe.name: Sardar Swaran Singh National Institute of Bio-Energy
in-sss-nibe.description: MNRE's autonomous institute for research, training and demonstration in bio-energy technologies (biomass, biogas, biofuels), based in Kapurthala, Punjab.

in-min-petroleum-and-natural-gas.name: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
in-min-petroleum-and-natural-gas.description: Formulates policy on exploration, production, refining, distribution and pricing of petroleum, natural gas and petroleum products, and owns India's national oil companies.
in-min-petroleum-and-natural-gas.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Oilfields (Regulation and Development) Act, 1948
in-min-petroleum-and-natural-gas.head: in-pos-minister-petroleum-and-natural-gas

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-ongc.name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited
in-ongc.description: India's largest crude-oil and natural-gas producer, a Maharatna CPSE responsible for the bulk of the country's domestic upstream (exploration & production) output onshore and offshore.
in-ongc.head: in-pos-chair-ongc

in-iocl.name: Indian Oil Corporation Limited
in-iocl.description: India's largest oil-marketing and refining company by volume, a Maharatna CPSE operating the country's largest refining network and fuel-retail chain.
in-iocl.head: in-pos-chair-iocl

in-bpcl.name: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited
in-bpcl.description: Maharatna oil-marketing and refining CPSE operating refineries at Mumbai, Kochi and Bina and a nationwide fuel-retail network.
in-bpcl.head: in-pos-chair-bpcl

in-hpcl.name: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited
in-hpcl.description: Maharatna oil-marketing and refining CPSE operating refineries at Mumbai and Visakhapatnam and a nationwide fuel-retail and LPG network.
in-hpcl.head: in-pos-chair-hpcl

in-gail.name: GAIL (India) Limited
in-gail.description: Maharatna CPSE and India's largest natural-gas transmission, trading, petrochemical and LPG-transmission company, operator of the national gas pipeline grid.
in-gail.head: in-pos-chair-gail

in-oil.name: Oil India Limited
in-oil.description: Second-largest national upstream oil & gas exploration and production CPSE (Navratna), historically centred on Assam/north-east India with a growing pan-India and overseas portfolio.
in-oil.head: in-pos-chair-oil

in-eil.name: Engineers India Limited
in-eil.description: Listed CPSE providing engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) and consultancy services for the hydrocarbon, petrochemical and process industries.
in-eil.head: in-pos-chair-eil

in-mrpl.name: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited
in-mrpl.description: Refining CPSE operating a large refinery-petrochemical complex at Mangaluru, Karnataka; a subsidiary of ONGC.
in-mrpl.head: in-pos-chair-mrpl

in-cpcl.name: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited
in-cpcl.description: Refining CPSE operating refineries at Manali and Nagapattinam in Tamil Nadu; a subsidiary of Indian Oil Corporation.
in-cpcl.head: in-pos-chair-cpcl

in-nrl.name: Numaligarh Refinery Limited
in-nrl.description: Refining CPSE operating a refinery at Numaligarh, Assam, jointly owned by Bharat Petroleum, Oil India and the Government of Assam.

in-dgh.name: Directorate General of Hydrocarbons
in-dgh.description: Technical arm of the Petroleum Ministry that regulates and monitors upstream exploration & production activity, administers hydrocarbon licensing rounds (OALP/HELP) and maintains India's E&P data repository.
in-dgh.head: in-pos-dg-dgh

in-ppac.name: Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell
in-ppac.description: Ministry think-tank/data cell that tracks petroleum-product pricing, subsidies, consumption and under-recoveries, and services the ministry's governing bodies with data and analysis.
in-ppac.head: in-pos-dg-ppac

in-isprl.name: Indian Strategic Petroleum Reserves Limited
in-isprl.description: Special-purpose CPSE that builds and manages India's underground strategic crude-oil reserve caverns (Visakhapatnam, Mangaluru, Padur) to cushion supply-disruption risk.
in-isprl.head: in-pos-md-isprl

in-pcra.name: Petroleum Conservation Research Association
in-pcra.description: Non-profit body funded by the Ministry and the oil industry that promotes petroleum-product conservation and fuel efficiency through R&D, training and public outreach.

in-min-coal.name: Ministry of Coal
in-min-coal.description: Formulates policy on exploration and development of coal and lignite reserves, and administers Coal India Limited and other coal-sector CPSEs that supply the bulk of India's thermal-power fuel.
in-min-coal.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Coal Mines (Nationalisation) Act, 1973; Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957
in-min-coal.head: in-pos-minister-coal

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Coal

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-coal-india.name: Coal India Limited
in-coal-india.description: World's largest coal-mining company by output, a Maharatna CPSE that produces roughly three-quarters of India's coal through seven production subsidiaries plus a planning/design subsidiary.
in-coal-india.head: in-pos-chair-coal-india

in-bccl.name: Bharat Coking Coal Limited
in-bccl.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around Jharkhand.

in-ccl.name: Central Coalfields Limited
in-ccl.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around Jharkhand.

in-ecl.name: Eastern Coalfields Limited
in-ecl.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around West Bengal.

in-mcl.name: Mahanadi Coalfields Limited
in-mcl.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around Odisha.

in-ncl.name: Northern Coalfields Limited
in-ncl.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around Madhya Pradesh.

in-secl.name: South Eastern Coalfields Limited
in-secl.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around Chhattisgarh.

in-wcl.name: Western Coalfields Limited
in-wcl.description: Wholly owned coal-mining production subsidiary of Coal India Limited operating in and around Maharashtra.

in-cmpdi.name: Central Mine Planning and Design Institute Limited
in-cmpdi.description: Coal India's mine-planning, exploration and consultancy subsidiary, providing geological exploration, project reports and technical support to all CIL production subsidiaries.

in-nlc-india.name: NLC India Limited
in-nlc-india.description: Navratna CPSE that mines lignite (mainly at Neyveli, Tamil Nadu, and Barsingsar, Rajasthan) and generates thermal and renewable power from it; formerly Neyveli Lignite Corporation.
in-nlc-india.head: in-pos-chair-nlc-india

in-coal-controller.name: Coal Controller's Organisation
in-coal-controller.description: Statutory office that registers coal/lignite producers and consumers, verifies grade/quality declarations of coal, and administers cess and captive-mine compliance under coal-sector law.
in-coal-controller.head: in-pos-coal-controller

in-min-mines.name: Ministry of Mines
in-min-mines.description: Formulates policy on survey and exploration of minerals (other than coal, petroleum and atomic minerals) and their regulated mining and development, and administers India's non-fuel mineral PSUs.
in-min-mines.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957
in-min-mines.head: in-pos-minister-mines

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Mines

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-gsi.name: Geological Survey of India
in-gsi.description: India's principal earth-science survey and mapping organisation, founded in 1851, that carries out geological mapping, mineral exploration and natural-hazard (landslide/seismic) assessment nationwide.
in-gsi.head: in-pos-dg-gsi

in-ibm.name: Indian Bureau of Mines
in-ibm.description: Regulatory and technical attached office that enforces mine conservation, scientific-development and mineral-conservation rules, approves mining plans and compiles national mineral statistics.
in-ibm.head: in-pos-cg-ibm

in-nalco.name: National Aluminium Company Limited
in-nalco.description: Navratna, vertically integrated CPSE spanning bauxite mining, alumina refining, aluminium smelting and captive power generation, based in Odisha.
in-nalco.head: in-pos-chair-nalco

in-hindustan-copper.name: Hindustan Copper Limited
in-hindustan-copper.description: India's only vertically integrated copper-mining-to-refining CPSE, operating mines at Malanjkhand, Khetri and other sites.
in-hindustan-copper.head: in-pos-chair-hindustan-copper

in-mecl.name: Mineral Exploration and Consultancy Limited
in-mecl.description: CPSE specialising in mineral exploration (drilling, geological surveys) and consultancy services for coal, lignite and other minerals, based in Nagpur.
in-mecl.head: in-pos-chair-mecl

in-kabil.name: Khanij Bidesh India Limited
in-kabil.description: Joint-venture CPSE of NALCO, Hindustan Copper and MECL created in 2019 to identify, acquire and develop critical- and strategic-mineral assets overseas (e.g. lithium, cobalt) for India's supply security.
in-kabil.head: in-pos-chair-kabil

in-jnarddc.name: Jawaharlal Nehru Aluminium Research Development and Design Centre
in-jnarddc.description: Autonomous R&D institute under the Ministry of Mines dedicated to aluminium and non-ferrous-metal research, based in Nagpur.

in-min-steel.name: Ministry of Steel
in-min-steel.description: Formulates policy on the iron and steel industry and administers the steel-sector CPSEs; steel pricing/production itself is largely deregulated and market-driven since the 1990s.
in-min-steel.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-steel.head: in-pos-minister-steel

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Steel

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-sail.name: Steel Authority of India Limited
in-sail.description: Maharatna CPSE and India's largest integrated public-sector steel producer, operating major integrated steel plants at Bhilai, Rourkela, Durgapur, Bokaro and Burnpur.
in-sail.head: in-pos-chair-sail

in-nmdc.name: NMDC Limited
in-nmdc.description: Navratna CPSE and India's largest iron-ore producer/exporter by volume, also mining diamond, copper and other minerals; formerly National Mineral Development Corporation.
in-nmdc.head: in-pos-chair-nmdc

in-rinl.name: Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited
in-rinl.description: CPSE operating the Visakhapatnam Steel Plant (Vizag Steel), India's first coastal-based integrated steel plant, entirely built on liquid-steel-through-blast-furnace route without any captive mines.
in-rinl.head: in-pos-chair-rinl

in-moil.name: MOIL Limited
in-moil.description: Listed CPSE and India's largest manganese-ore producer, operating mines mainly in Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh; formerly Manganese Ore (India) Limited.
in-moil.head: in-pos-chair-moil

in-mecon.name: MECON Limited
in-mecon.description: CPSE providing engineering-consultancy, design and project-management services mainly for the steel, power and infrastructure sectors, based in Ranchi.
in-mecon.head: in-pos-chair-mecon

in-kiocl.name: KIOCL Limited
in-kiocl.description: CPSE that produces iron-ore/pig-iron pellets, originally built around the (now-closed) Kudremukh iron-ore mine; formerly Kudremukh Iron Ore Company Limited.
in-kiocl.head: in-pos-chair-kiocl

in-min-heavy-industries.name: Ministry of Heavy Industries
in-min-heavy-industries.description: Formulates policy for the capital-goods, heavy-engineering and automobile/auto-components sectors, runs the FAME/PLI electric-mobility and auto incentive schemes, and administers heavy-engineering CPSEs.
in-min-heavy-industries.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-heavy-industries.head: in-pos-minister-heavy-industries

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Heavy Industries

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-bhel.name: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited
in-bhel.description: Maharatna CPSE and India's largest power-plant-equipment manufacturer, also making rail, defence, aerospace and renewable-energy equipment.
in-bhel.head: in-pos-chair-bhel

in-andrew-yule.name: Andrew Yule and Company Limited
in-andrew-yule.description: One of India's oldest managing-agency-turned-CPSEs (founded 1863), now a diversified small CPSE with engineering, electrical and tea-plantation businesses.
in-andrew-yule.head: in-pos-chair-andrew-yule

in-hec.name: Heavy Engineering Corporation Limited
in-hec.description: CPSE at Ranchi manufacturing heavy machinery for mining, steel and defence sectors; has for years operated under severe financial stress and periodic revival packages.

in-bridge-and-roof.name: Bridge and Roof Company (India) Limited
in-bridge-and-roof.description: CPSE providing heavy structural-engineering, fabrication and EPC services (bridges, industrial structures, offshore platforms), headquartered in Kolkata.

in-icat.name: International Centre for Automotive Technology
in-icat.description: Autonomous automotive testing, certification, homologation and R&D centre under the Ministry of Heavy Industries, based in Manesar, Haryana.

in-arai.name: Automotive Research Association of India
in-arai.description: Automotive homologation, testing, certification and R&D body co-operatively run by the automobile industry under the administrative umbrella of the Ministry of Heavy Industries, headquartered in Pune.

in-dept-atomic-energy.name: Department of Atomic Energy
in-dept-atomic-energy.description: Independent department directly under the Prime Minister responsible for nuclear power generation, nuclear-fuel-cycle facilities, nuclear research and India's strategic atomic programme; chairs also head the Atomic Energy Commission.
in-dept-atomic-energy.legalBasis: Atomic Energy Act, 1962; Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-dept-atomic-energy.head: in-pos-prime-minister

members.title: Minister of State in the Department of Atomic Energy

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-aec.name: Atomic Energy Commission
in-aec.description: Apex policy-making body for India's atomic-energy programme, chaired ex officio by the Secretary, Department of Atomic Energy, that approves DAE's plans, budgets and major programme decisions.
in-aec.head: in-pos-chairman-aec

in-barc.name: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre
in-barc.description: India's premier multidisciplinary nuclear-research centre (est. 1954 by Homi Bhabha), covering reactor design, nuclear fuel cycle, nuclear medicine, materials science and national-security-related R&D, based at Trombay, Mumbai.
in-barc.head: in-pos-director-barc

in-npcil.name: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited
in-npcil.description: CPSE that designs, builds and operates all of India's civil nuclear-power reactors, working under the Atomic Energy Act's requirement that nuclear generation stay government-owned.
in-npcil.head: in-pos-chair-npcil

in-bhavini.name: Bharatiya Nabhikiya Vidyut Nigam Limited
in-bhavini.description: CPSE set up to build and operate India's fast-breeder reactor programme, starting with the Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor (PFBR) at Kalpakkam.
in-bhavini.head: in-pos-chair-bhavini

in-ucil.name: Uranium Corporation of India Limited
in-ucil.description: CPSE that mines and mills uranium ore, mainly from the Singhbhum belt in Jharkhand, to supply India's nuclear-fuel-cycle facilities.
in-ucil.head: in-pos-chair-ucil

in-irel.name: IREL (India) Limited
in-irel.description: CPSE (formerly Indian Rare Earths Limited) that mines beach-sand minerals and processes rare-earth and other strategic minerals for the nuclear, defence and electronics industries.
in-irel.head: in-pos-chair-irel

in-ecil.name: Electronics Corporation of India Limited
in-ecil.description: CPSE founded by DAE to build strategic and nuclear-grade electronics, instrumentation, e-voting machines and process-control systems for government use.
in-ecil.head: in-pos-chair-ecil

in-aerb.name: Atomic Energy Regulatory Board
in-aerb.description: India's nuclear and radiological safety regulator, issuing licences for and inspecting nuclear power plants, radiation facilities and the transport of radioactive material; reports administratively to DAE while functioning as an independent safety authority.
in-aerb.legalBasis: Atomic Energy Act, 1962 (delegated authority); established by Presidential order 1983
in-aerb.head: in-pos-chairman-aerb

in-tifr.name: Tata Institute of Fundamental Research
in-tifr.description: DAE's flagship deemed-university research institute for fundamental physics, mathematics, biology and computer science, founded with Tata Trust support in 1945 and now grant-in-aid funded by DAE.

in-hbni.name: Homi Bhabha National Institute
in-hbni.description: Deemed university that is the common academic umbrella for DAE's constituent research institutions (BARC, IGCAR, VECC, RRCAT, TIFR, IPR, SINP and others), awarding degrees for doctoral and integrated research training across them.

in-igcar.name: Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research
in-igcar.description: DAE's principal centre for fast-reactor technology and related materials science, based at Kalpakkam, Tamil Nadu.

in-vecc.name: Variable Energy Cyclotron Centre
in-vecc.description: DAE research centre in Kolkata operating cyclotron and superconducting-cyclotron accelerators for nuclear-physics, materials-science and radioisotope-production research.

in-rrcat.name: Raja Ramanna Centre for Advanced Technology
in-rrcat.description: DAE research centre in Indore developing laser and accelerator technologies, including free-electron lasers and synchrotron-radiation sources (Indus-1/Indus-2).

in-ipr-plasma-research.name: Institute for Plasma Research
in-ipr-plasma-research.description: DAE-funded autonomous research institute at Gandhinagar dedicated to plasma physics and fusion-energy research, including India's Aditya and SST-1 tokamaks.

in-sinp.name: Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics
in-sinp.description: DAE grant-in-aid research institute in Kolkata, founded by physicist Meghnad Saha, covering nuclear and particle physics, condensed-matter physics and materials science.

in-dept-space.name: Department of Space
in-dept-space.description: Independent department directly under the Prime Minister responsible for India's space programme — satellite and launch-vehicle development, space applications, and space-sector policy and promotion — executed mainly through ISRO and its associated bodies.
in-dept-space.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-dept-space.head: in-pos-prime-minister

members.title: Minister of State in the Department of Space

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-space-commission.name: Space Commission
in-space-commission.description: Apex policy body for India's space programme, chaired ex officio by the Secretary, Department of Space, mirroring the Atomic Energy Commission's role for the nuclear programme.
in-space-commission.head: in-pos-chairman-space-commission

in-isro.name: Indian Space Research Organisation
in-isro.description: India's national space agency, responsible for designing, building and launching satellites and launch vehicles (PSLV, GSLV, LVM3) and running the country's civilian space missions (Chandrayaan, Gaganyaan, Aditya-L1 and others) through a network of specialised centres.
in-isro.head: in-pos-chairman-isro

in-vssc.name: Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre
in-vssc.description: ISRO's lead centre for launch-vehicle design and development, based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
in-vssc.head: in-pos-director-vssc

in-ursc.name: U R Rao Satellite Centre
in-ursc.description: ISRO's lead centre for spacecraft design, integration and testing, based in Bengaluru; formerly ISRO Satellite Centre (ISAC).

in-sdsc-shar.name: Satish Dhawan Space Centre
in-sdsc-shar.description: ISRO's primary launch site (spaceport) at Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh, from which nearly all Indian orbital launches are conducted.

in-lpsc.name: Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre
in-lpsc.description: ISRO's lead centre for liquid, cryogenic and semi-cryogenic rocket-propulsion systems, with campuses at Thiruvananthapuram, Bengaluru and Mahendragiri.
in-lpsc.head: in-pos-director-lpsc

in-sac.name: Space Applications Centre
in-sac.description: ISRO centre in Ahmedabad developing satellite payloads (communication, remote-sensing, meteorology, navigation) and applications of space technology for national development.
in-sac.head: in-pos-director-sac

in-nrsc.name: National Remote Sensing Centre
in-nrsc.description: ISRO centre in Hyderabad that acquires and processes satellite remote-sensing data and runs India's disaster-management and geospatial-data-support services.
in-nrsc.head: in-pos-director-nrsc

in-iprc.name: ISRO Propulsion Complex
in-iprc.description: ISRO's rocket-propulsion static-testing and propellant-production facility at Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu.

in-hsfc.name: Human Space Flight Centre
in-hsfc.description: ISRO centre coordinating India's human-spaceflight programme (Gaganyaan) — crew module, life-support, training and mission-management systems.

in-istrac.name: ISRO Telemetry, Tracking and Command Network
in-istrac.description: ISRO's satellite tracking, telemetry and command network, coordinating ground stations across India and overseas for satellite and launch-vehicle operations.

in-iisu.name: ISRO Inertial Systems Unit
in-iisu.description: ISRO centre at Thiruvananthapuram developing inertial-navigation and guidance systems for launch vehicles and spacecraft.

in-nesac.name: North Eastern Space Applications Centre
in-nesac.description: Joint ISRO/DoS and North Eastern Council centre in Shillong applying space technology to development needs of India's north-eastern states.

in-iirs.name: Indian Institute of Remote Sensing
in-iirs.description: ISRO's training and education institute in Dehradun for remote sensing, GIS and geoinformatics, offering courses to Indian and international scientists and officials.

in-iist.name: Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology
in-iist.description: India's first autonomous space-sector university, set up by the Department of Space at Thiruvananthapuram to train aerospace and space-technology engineers and scientists, largely for ISRO.

in-nsil.name: NewSpace India Limited
in-nsil.description: CPSE (commercial arm of the Department of Space) that manufactures and transfers ISRO-developed launch vehicles and satellites to industry, sells space-based services and executes commercial launch contracts.
in-nsil.head: in-pos-cmd-nsil

in-in-space.name: Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre
in-in-space.description: Single-window autonomous body that authorises, promotes and regulates private-sector space activities in India (satellite, launch-vehicle and ground-segment ventures), created as part of the 2020 opening-up of the space sector to private industry.
in-in-space.head: in-pos-chairman-in-space

in-antrix.name: Antrix Corporation Limited
in-antrix.description: DoS's original commercial marketing arm, historically handling satellite-transponder leasing and technology transfer; most new commercial functions have since moved to NSIL.
in-antrix.head: in-pos-cmd-antrix

in-prl.name: Physical Research Laboratory
in-prl.description: DoS-funded autonomous research institute in Ahmedabad for space and atmospheric sciences, astrophysics, planetary science and astronomy — India's leading centre for these fields.
in-prl.head: in-pos-director-prl

in-cpri.name: Central Power Research Institute
in-cpri.description: Ministry of Power's autonomous applied-research and high-power/high-voltage testing institute for electrical equipment, headquartered in Bengaluru with regional testing labs across India.

in-nuclear-fuel-complex.name: Nuclear Fuel Complex
in-nuclear-fuel-complex.description: DAE production unit in Hyderabad that manufactures nuclear-fuel assemblies, zirconium-alloy reactor components and other nuclear-grade materials for India's power and research reactors.

in-heavy-water-board.name: Heavy Water Board
in-heavy-water-board.description: DAE production organisation operating India's heavy-water plants, which supply the moderator/coolant used in the country's PHWR nuclear power reactors.

in-rec-power-distribution.name: REC Power Distribution Company Limited
in-rec-power-distribution.description: Wholly owned subsidiary of REC Limited that provides power-distribution-reform consultancy and implements central distribution schemes (e.g. RDSS) on behalf of state utilities.

in-rec-transmission-projects.name: REC Transmission Projects Company Limited
in-rec-transmission-projects.description: Wholly owned subsidiary of REC Limited that incubates inter-state transmission projects, bidding them out under the tariff-based competitive bidding route before transferring them to winning developers.

in-min-agriculture-and-farmers-welfare.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
in-min-agriculture-and-farmers-welfare.description: The nodal ministry for crop agriculture policy, farmer income-support and credit schemes, agricultural research/education (via ICAR) and crop insurance; it runs PM-KISAN and PMFBY.
in-min-agriculture-and-farmers-welfare.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-agriculture-and-farmers-welfare.head: in-pos-minister-agriculture-and-farmers-welfare

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Minister of State in the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-agriculture-and-farmers-welfare.name: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
aliases: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare (former name)
in-dept-agriculture-and-farmers-welfare.description: Runs crop-husbandry policy, minimum support price operations liaison, seeds, fertiliser-use extension, farm credit, PM-KISAN and PMFBY; the larger of the ministry's two departments (DA&FW).
in-dept-agriculture-and-farmers-welfare.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-agricultural-research-and-educat.name: Department of Agricultural Research and Education
in-dept-agricultural-research-and-educat.description: The department that funds and directs India's agricultural research system; its Secretary is concurrently Director-General of ICAR, which the department administers.
in-dept-agricultural-research-and-educat.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-min-fisheries-animal-husbandry-and-da.name: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
in-min-fisheries-animal-husbandry-and-da.description: Carved out of the Agriculture Ministry in 2019; covers fisheries development, livestock health and breeding, and the dairy cooperative sector (through NDDB).
in-min-fisheries-animal-husbandry-and-da.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-fisheries-animal-husbandry-and-da.head: in-pos-minister-fisheries-animal-husbandry-and-dairying

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
Minister of State in the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-fisheries.name: Department of Fisheries
in-dept-fisheries.description: Administers the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana and India's fisheries and aquaculture development, including the National Fisheries Development Board.
in-dept-fisheries.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-animal-husbandry-and-dairying.name: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
in-dept-animal-husbandry-and-dairying.description: Runs national livestock-health, breed-improvement and dairy-development programmes (Rashtriya Gokul Mission, National Livestock Mission) and administers NDDB.
in-dept-animal-husbandry-and-dairying.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-min-food-processing-industries.name: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
in-min-food-processing-industries.description: Promotes food-processing investment and infrastructure (mega food parks, cold chains) and runs the PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises scheme.
in-min-food-processing-industries.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-food-processing-industries.head: in-pos-minister-food-processing-industries

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Food Processing Industries

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-min-consumer-affairs-food-and-public-.name: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
in-min-consumer-affairs-food-and-public-.description: Umbrella ministry for consumer protection, weights/measures, standards (BIS), food procurement and the public distribution system; has two departments.
in-min-consumer-affairs-food-and-public-.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-consumer-affairs-food-and-public-.head: in-pos-minister-consumer-affairs-food-and-public-distribution

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
Minister of State in the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-consumer-affairs.name: Department of Consumer Affairs
in-dept-consumer-affairs.description: Administers the Consumer Protection Act 2019 (via CCPA and the consumer commissions), Legal Metrology, BIS standards and the National Test House.
in-dept-consumer-affairs.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-food-and-public-distribution.name: Department of Food and Public Distribution
in-dept-food-and-public-distribution.description: Runs foodgrain procurement, buffer-stock and the public distribution system through FCI, CWC and WDRA, and administers PMGKAY free-foodgrain distribution under the NFSA.
in-dept-food-and-public-distribution.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; National Food Security Act, 2013

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-min-rural-development.name: Ministry of Rural Development
in-min-rural-development.description: India's principal poverty-alleviation and rural-infrastructure ministry: rural roads (PMGSY), rural housing (PMAY-G), rural livelihoods (DAY-NRLM) and the rural employment guarantee (now VB-G RAM-G).
in-min-rural-development.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-rural-development.head: in-pos-minister-rural-development

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Rural Development
Minister of State in the Ministry of Rural Development

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-rural-development.name: Department of Rural Development
in-dept-rural-development.description: Runs DAY-NRLM, PMAY-Gramin, PMGSY (through NRIDA), the National Social Assistance Programme and the successor to MGNREGA.
in-dept-rural-development.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-land-resources.name: Department of Land Resources
in-dept-land-resources.description: Runs land-records digitisation (DILRMP) and watershed/wasteland development programmes.
in-dept-land-resources.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-min-panchayati-raj.name: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
in-min-panchayati-raj.description: Nodal ministry for the three-tier rural local self-government system mandated by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment; runs the Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan for panchayat capacity-building.
in-min-panchayati-raj.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Part IX, Constitution of India
in-min-panchayati-raj.head: in-pos-minister-panchayati-raj

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Panchayati Raj

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-min-chemicals-and-fertilizers.name: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
in-min-chemicals-and-fertilizers.description: Runs India's chemicals/petrochemicals industrial policy, the fertiliser subsidy system and pharmaceutical pricing/production policy across three departments.
in-min-chemicals-and-fertilizers.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-chemicals-and-fertilizers.head: in-pos-minister-chemicals-and-fertilizers

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-chemicals-and-petrochemicals.name: Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals
in-dept-chemicals-and-petrochemicals.description: Administers chemicals/petrochemicals industry policy and the CIPET and IPFT training/research institutes.
in-dept-chemicals-and-petrochemicals.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-fertilizers.name: Department of Fertilizers
in-dept-fertilizers.description: Administers the fertiliser subsidy (Nutrient Based Subsidy scheme) and owns/oversees the central fertiliser PSUs.
in-dept-fertilizers.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-pharmaceuticals.name: Department of Pharmaceuticals
in-dept-pharmaceuticals.description: Regulates drug pricing (through NPPA), affordable-medicine retail (Jan Aushadhi, through BPPI) and pharma education/research (NIPERs); drug safety/licensing (CDSCO) sits with the Health Ministry instead.
in-dept-pharmaceuticals.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-icar.name: Indian Council of Agricultural Research
in-icar.description: India's apex agricultural research body: a registered society running dozens of national institutes, national research centres, national bureaux and agricultural universities. Wikipedia (as of ~2020, not independently recounted this pass) listed roughly 113 constituent units — 4 deemed universities, 65 institutes, 15 national research centres, 6 national bureaux and 13 project directorates, plus 11 zonal Agricultural Technology Application Research Institutes (ATARIs); the current count needs a fresh ICAR annual-report check.
in-icar.legalBasis: Registered as a society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 (1929); administered under DARE

stats.asOfNote: Wikipedia figure, circa 2020, not re-verified in this pass

in-cacp.name: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices
in-cacp.description: Attached office of the Agriculture Department that recommends Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for major crops each season; advisory only — MSP is set by the Union Cabinet.
in-cacp.legalBasis: Government of India Resolution (established as Agricultural Prices Commission, 1965; renamed 1985)
in-cacp.head: in-pos-chair-cacp

in-nafed.name: National Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation of India
in-nafed.description: A national apex multi-state cooperative society (not a CPSE) that undertakes price-support procurement of pulses/oilseeds on the government's behalf and markets agricultural produce for farmer cooperatives.
in-nafed.head: in-pos-chair-nafed

in-nsc-seeds.name: National Seeds Corporation
in-nsc-seeds.description: Central public sector undertaking that produces and distributes certified/foundation seed and multiplies breeder seed from ICAR institutes.

in-sfci.name: State Farms Corporation of India
in-sfci.description: Central public sector undertaking that runs government seed/demonstration farms and produces quality seed.

in-sfac.name: Small Farmers' Agribusiness Consortium
in-sfac.description: Society that promotes Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs) and agribusiness venture-capital assistance for small and marginal farmers.

in-dmi-agriculture.name: Directorate of Marketing and Inspection
in-dmi-agriculture.description: Subordinate office that grades and standardises agricultural produce (AGMARK) and advises on agricultural marketing infrastructure and regulation.

in-nraa.name: National Rainfed Area Authority
in-nraa.description: Advisory body on rainfed-area development and watershed management, housed in NITI Aayog/the Agriculture Department.

in-niphm.name: National Institute of Plant Health Management
in-niphm.description: Autonomous institute that trains extension officers and farmers in integrated pest management, plant quarantine and pesticide management.

in-cfqcti.name: Central Fertiliser Quality Control and Training Institute
in-cfqcti.description: Subordinate office (with regional labs) that tests fertiliser quality and trains state fertiliser-inspection staff.

in-mission-pm-kisan.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
in-mission-pm-kisan.description: Direct income-support scheme paying eligible landholding farmer families ₹6,000/year in three instalments straight to their bank accounts via Aadhaar-seeded DBT.
in-mission-pm-kisan.legalBasis: Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approval, February 2019

in-mission-pmfby.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
in-mission-pmfby.description: Government-subsidised crop-insurance scheme protecting farmers against yield losses from natural calamities, pests and disease; implemented through empanelled insurers including AIC.

in-nddb.name: National Dairy Development Board
in-nddb.description: Statutory body (an Institution of National Importance) that promotes India's dairy cooperative structure ('Operation Flood'/Amul model) — production, procurement and marketing of milk.
in-nddb.head: in-pos-chair-nddb

in-nfdb.name: National Fisheries Development Board
in-nfdb.description: Autonomous body under the Department of Fisheries that funds and coordinates fisheries and aquaculture development schemes, including under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana.
in-nfdb.legalBasis: Registered society under the Department of Fisheries

in-caa-fisheries.name: Coastal Aquaculture Authority
in-caa-fisheries.description: Statutory regulator that registers and regulates coastal shrimp/fish farms to protect the coastal environment.

in-cifnet.name: Central Institute of Fisheries, Nautical and Engineering Training
in-cifnet.description: Subordinate office that trains marine fishing crews and fisheries engineers.

in-mission-rashtriya-gokul.name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission
in-mission-rashtriya-gokul.description: Flagship cattle/buffalo indigenous-breed development and conservation mission under the National Programme for Bovine Breeding and Dairy Development.

in-mission-national-livestock.name: National Livestock Mission
in-mission-national-livestock.description: Scheme for livestock development covering breed improvement, fodder development, and entrepreneurship in poultry/small ruminants/pigs.

in-niftem.name: National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management
in-niftem.description: Institute of National Importance for food-technology education, entrepreneurship and R&D, with campuses at Kundli (Haryana) and Thanjavur (Tamil Nadu, the former IIFPT).
in-niftem.legalBasis: National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management Act, 2021

in-mission-mega-food-parks.name: Mega Food Park Scheme
in-mission-mega-food-parks.description: Scheme funding cluster-based food-processing infrastructure (mega food parks) linking farm produce to retail/export markets.

in-mission-pmfme.name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme
in-mission-pmfme.description: Scheme supporting formalisation, credit access and branding for unorganised micro food-processing units, often on a one-district-one-product basis.
in-mission-pmfme.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval (Atmanirbhar Bharat package)

in-fci.name: Food Corporation of India
in-fci.description: Statutory corporation that procures foodgrain (chiefly rice and wheat) at MSP, maintains buffer stocks for food security, and supplies grain to the public distribution system.
in-fci.head: in-pos-cmd-fci

in-wdra.name: Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority
in-wdra.description: Regulator that licenses warehouses and registers Negotiable Warehouse Receipts (NWRs), enabling farmers to pledge stored produce for credit.

in-bis.name: Bureau of Indian Standards
in-bis.description: India's national standards body: sets and certifies (ISI mark) product/service standards, hallmarks precious metals, and runs the Sathyabama-run product-certification and lab-testing systems.
in-bis.head: in-pos-dg-bis

in-nth.name: National Test House
in-nth.description: Subordinate office providing third-party materials/product testing and calibration services, with regional laboratories, under the Department of Consumer Affairs.

in-legal-metrology.name: Legal Metrology Division
in-legal-metrology.description: Central regulator for weights and measures (packaged-commodity declarations, weighing/measuring instrument approval); enforcement is largely by State Legal Metrology departments.

in-ccpa.name: Central Consumer Protection Authority
in-ccpa.description: Regulator with powers to investigate and act against unfair trade practices, misleading/false advertising and violations of consumer rights, including recalls.
in-ccpa.head: in-pos-chief-commissioner-ccpa

in-sugar-directorate.name: Directorate of Sugar and Vegetable Oils
in-sugar-directorate.description: Subordinate office that administers sugar-sector policy (cane pricing liaison, sugar-mill data, export/stock rules) within the Food & PD department.

in-mission-pmgkay.name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
in-mission-pmgkay.description: Free-foodgrain scheme — 5 kg/person/month on top of NFSA entitlements — launched as COVID-19 relief in March 2020 and since folded into free (rather than subsidised) NFSA distribution, with the free-grain policy extended to December 2028.
in-mission-pmgkay.legalBasis: Cabinet approval, March 2020; extension Cabinet approvals through 2028; operates within the National Food Security Act, 2013 framework

in-nirdpr.name: National Institute of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj
in-nirdpr.description: Apex national training and research institute for rural development and panchayati raj functionaries, with a main campus in Hyderabad and centres in Guwahati and Delhi.
in-nirdpr.legalBasis: Registered society under the Ministry of Rural Development (established 1964 as National Institute of Community Development)

in-mission-nrlm.name: DAY-NRLM (National Rural Livelihood Mission)
in-mission-nrlm.description: Self-help-group-based poverty-alleviation mission mobilising rural women into SHGs for savings, credit and livelihood promotion; the World Bank-supported National Rural Economic Transformation Project (NRETP) is a sub-project deepening NRLM's livelihoods and financial-inclusion work in select states.
in-mission-nrlm.legalBasis: Restructuring of the Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana; renamed Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-NRLM in 2015

in-mission-vb-g-ram-g.name: Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)
aliases: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
in-mission-vb-g-ram-g.description: The rural employment-guarantee mission that replaced MGNREGA: raises the guaranteed-work entitlement from 100 to 125 days/year, revises Centre-State funding shares (60:40 generally, 90:10 for NE/Himalayan states), and adds steering committees and tech-based monitoring. The enabling Act was passed by both Houses on 18 December 2025, repealing the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, 2005.
in-mission-vb-g-ram-g.legalBasis: Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025 (repeals the MGNREGA, 2005)
in-mission-vb-g-ram-g.established: 2025-12-18 (passed by Parliament; commencement date not independently confirmed)

in-nrida.name: National Rural Infrastructure Development Agency
in-nrida.description: Implementing agency for PMGSY (rural roads) and other rural-infrastructure programmes on behalf of the Department of Rural Development.
in-nrida.legalBasis: Registered society under the Ministry of Rural Development

in-mission-pmgsy.name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
in-mission-pmgsy.description: Centrally sponsored scheme to give unconnected rural habitations all-weather road connectivity; now in its fourth phase (PMGSY-IV, covering smaller habitations and left-wing-extremism/aspirational districts), implemented through NRIDA.
in-mission-pmgsy.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval, December 2000

in-mission-spmrm.name: Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission
in-mission-spmrm.description: Mission clustering neighbouring villages into 'rurban' growth clusters with urban-grade infrastructure while preserving rural character.

in-mission-ddu-gky.name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
in-mission-ddu-gky.description: Placement-linked skill-training scheme for rural youth from poor families, run under the NRLM umbrella.

in-mission-pmay-gramin.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin
in-mission-pmay-gramin.description: Rural housing scheme giving pucca houses with basic amenities to houseless/inadequately-housed rural families; the restructured successor to the Indira Awaas Yojana.

in-mission-nsap.name: National Social Assistance Programme
in-mission-nsap.description: Umbrella social-pension scheme for elderly, widowed and disabled people below the poverty line (old-age, widow and disability pensions, and a family-benefit grant), part-funded by the Centre and topped up by states.
in-mission-nsap.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval, Article 41 (Directive Principles)

in-mission-dilrmp.name: Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme
in-mission-dilrmp.description: Programme to digitise land records, computerise registration and integrate them towards a conclusive land-titling system.
in-mission-dilrmp.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval (merger of NLRMP, 2008)

in-mission-rgsa.name: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan
in-mission-rgsa.description: Capacity-building scheme for Panchayati Raj Institutions covering training, e-governance (eGramSwaraj) and devolution support.

in-hil.name: Hindustan Insecticides Limited
in-hil.description: Central public sector undertaking manufacturing technical-grade pesticides (originally DDT for malaria control) and agrochemicals, with plants in Kerala, Maharashtra and Punjab.

in-cipet.name: Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering and Technology
in-cipet.description: National institute for skill development, education and R&D in plastics/petrochemicals engineering, with a large multi-city network of centres (40+ operational plus several under development).
in-cipet.legalBasis: Registered society under the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals (formerly Central Institute of Plastics Engineering and Technology)
in-cipet.head: in-pos-dg-cipet

in-ipft.name: Institute of Pesticide Formulation Technology
in-ipft.description: Institute researching and developing pesticide-formulation technology and providing testing/consultancy to the agrochemical industry.
in-ipft.legalBasis: Registered society under the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals

in-nfl.name: National Fertilizers Limited
in-nfl.description: Navratna central public sector undertaking and India's second-largest urea producer, with plants at Nangal, Bathinda, Panipat and Vijaipur.

in-rcf.name: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers
in-rcf.description: Central public sector undertaking (Government of India holds a majority stake) manufacturing urea and complex fertilisers plus industrial chemicals, headquartered in Mumbai.
in-rcf.legalBasis: Companies Act (formed 1978 from the split of Fertilizer Corporation of India)

in-fact.name: Fertilizers and Chemicals Travancore
in-fact.description: One of India's oldest fertiliser companies, a central public sector undertaking based in Kochi, Kerala, producing ammonium sulphate/factamfos fertilisers and caprolactam.

in-bvfcl.name: Brahmaputra Valley Fertilizer Corporation Limited
in-bvfcl.description: Central public sector undertaking operating urea plants at Namrup, Assam, serving the north-eastern fertiliser market.

in-hurl.name: Hindustan Urvarak and Rasayan Limited
in-hurl.description: Joint-venture company (Coal India, NTPC, IOCL, FCIL and HFCL) reviving and operating revamped gas-based urea plants at Gorakhpur, Sindri and Barauni.

in-mfl-fertilizers.name: Madras Fertilizers Limited
in-mfl-fertilizers.description: Central public sector undertaking producing urea and complex fertilisers from a plant at Manali, Chennai; originally a joint venture with AMOCO and NIOC.

in-nppa.name: National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority
in-nppa.description: Independent regulator that fixes/revises ceiling prices of scheduled (essential) medicines and monitors drug availability and prices nationally.
in-nppa.head: in-pos-chair-nppa

in-niper-aggregate.name: NIPERs (National Institutes of Pharmaceutical Education and Research)
in-niper-aggregate.description: Institutes of National Importance for pharmaceutical education/research; seven campuses — Mohali (1998, the original), Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Guwahati, Hajipur and Raebareli (2007-08).
in-niper-aggregate.legalBasis: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research Act, 1998

in-bppi.name: Bureau of Pharma PSUs of India
in-bppi.description: Implementing agency for the Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana, running Jan Aushadhi Kendra outlets that sell generic medicines at low prices; set up by pooling the pharma CPSEs.
in-bppi.legalBasis: Registered society under the Department of Pharmaceuticals

in-mission-pmbjp.name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana
in-mission-pmbjp.description: Scheme establishing dedicated outlets (Jan Aushadhi Kendras) selling quality generic medicines at prices well below branded equivalents, implemented through BPPI.

in-hal-antibiotics.name: Hindustan Antibiotics Limited
in-hal-antibiotics.description: Central public sector undertaking (Pimpri, Pune) manufacturing bulk drugs/antibiotics (notably penicillin); has faced prolonged financial stress, with disinvestment/closure repeatedly considered — current operational status not independently verified in this pass.

in-idpl.name: Indian Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited
in-idpl.description: Central public sector undertaking that was once India's largest bulk-drug maker; has been financially sick for years, with several units referred for closure/strategic disinvestment — current operational status not independently verified in this pass.

in-bcpl-pharma.name: Bengal Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals Limited
in-bcpl-pharma.description: Central public sector undertaking (founded by P.C. Ray) producing pharmaceuticals and fine chemicals from plants in West Bengal.

in-kapl.name: Karnataka Antibiotics and Pharmaceuticals Limited
in-kapl.description: Central public sector undertaking manufacturing bulk drugs and formulations (notably anti-TB and anti-malarial drugs) from Bengaluru.
in-kapl.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking, Government of Karnataka is a minority shareholder)

in-rdpl.name: Rajasthan Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited
in-rdpl.description: Central public sector undertaking manufacturing bulk drugs, based in Jaipur.

in-dppqs.name: Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine and Storage
in-dppqs.description: Subordinate office regulating pesticide registration/quality, plant quarantine at ports of entry, and locust control, under the Insecticides Act and the Destructive Insects and Pests Act.
in-dppqs.legalBasis: Insecticides Act, 1968; Destructive Insects and Pests Act, 1914

in-mission-rkvy.name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana
in-mission-rkvy.description: Umbrella state-plan scheme giving states flexible funding to raise agriculture/allied-sector growth, planned through State Agriculture Plans.
in-mission-rkvy.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval, National Development Council

in-cpdo.name: Central Poultry Development Organisation
in-cpdo.description: Network of central poultry farms/training institutes (Central Poultry Development Organisation, four zonal units) that supply improved poultry germplasm and train poultry farmers.

in-min-health-and-family-welfare.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
in-min-health-and-family-welfare.description: Runs India's public-health policy, disease control, medical education regulation and health insurance programmes (Ayushman Bharat), through two departments: Health & Family Welfare, and Health Research.
in-min-health-and-family-welfare.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961
in-min-health-and-family-welfare.head: in-pos-minister-health-and-family-welfare

members.title: Minister of State in the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Minister of State in the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-health-and-family-welfare.name: Department of Health and Family Welfare
in-dept-health-and-family-welfare.description: The main administrative department of the health ministry: public health programmes, hospitals, medical education regulation (via NMC/NBEMS), drug regulation (CDSCO) and health insurance (NHA).
in-dept-health-and-family-welfare.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dept-health-research.name: Department of Health Research
in-dept-health-research.description: Coordinates biomedical research policy and administers the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR); the Secretary, DHR is ex-officio Director-General of ICMR.
in-dept-health-research.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; created 2007

budget.source: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/index.php (Union Budget 2026-2027 portal, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India; verified budget presented 1 Feb 2026 by FM Nirmala Sitharaman)

in-dghs.name: Directorate General of Health Services
in-dghs.description: The technical wing of the health ministry: runs central government hospitals/institutes, medical stores depots and public-health advisory functions, headed by the Director General of Health Services.
in-dghs.head: in-pos-dghs

in-icmr.name: Indian Council of Medical Research
in-icmr.description: India's apex biomedical research body, running ~30 national research institutes on TB, malaria, cancer, nutrition and other health priorities; funded through the Department of Health Research.
in-icmr.legalBasis: Registered society (1949, successor to the 1911 Indian Research Fund Association)
in-icmr.head: in-pos-secretary-health-research

in-cdsco.name: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation
in-cdsco.description: India's national regulator for pharmaceuticals, medical devices and cosmetics — approves new drugs/devices, sets standards and runs post-market surveillance, headed by the Drugs Controller General of India (DCGI).
in-cdsco.head: in-pos-dcgi

in-fssai.name: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
in-fssai.description: Statutory food-safety regulator: sets food standards, licenses food businesses and enforces the Food Safety and Standards Act through State/UT food safety officers.
in-fssai.head: in-pos-chairperson-fssai

in-nmc.name: National Medical Commission
in-nmc.description: Regulates medical education and practitioners in modern (allopathic) medicine: accredits medical colleges, licenses doctors and oversees NEET-based admissions; replaced the Medical Council of India in 2020.
in-nmc.head: in-pos-chairperson-nmc

in-nbems.name: National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences
in-nbems.description: Conducts postgraduate medical entrance/exit exams (NEET-PG, NEET-SS, FMGE) and awards the DNB/DrNB postgraduate medical qualifications, in parallel to university-based medical postgraduate education.
in-nbems.head: in-pos-president-nbems

in-nha.name: National Health Authority
in-nha.description: Implements Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY), India's flagship public health-insurance scheme covering hospitalisation for economically vulnerable families, and the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission.
in-nha.head: in-pos-ceo-nha

in-naco.name: National AIDS Control Organisation
in-naco.description: Runs India's HIV/AIDS prevention and control programme through State AIDS Control Societies, blood-safety surveillance and antiretroviral treatment centres.
in-naco.head: in-pos-dg-naco

in-cghs.name: Central Government Health Scheme
in-cghs.description: Provides healthcare to serving and retired central government employees and other eligible beneficiaries through wellness centres in 80+ cities.
in-cghs.head: in-pos-dg-cghs

in-hll-lifecare.name: HLL Lifecare Limited
in-hll-lifecare.description: Central public-sector healthcare-products manufacturer (condoms, contraceptives, surgical sutures, blood bags) and operator of the Amrit low-cost-medicine pharmacy chain; a long-pending disinvestment has not been completed.
in-hll-lifecare.head: in-pos-cmd-hll

in-nihfw.name: National Institute of Health and Family Welfare
in-nihfw.description: Apex training and research institute for health administrators and public-health managers, and a WHO collaborating centre.

in-aiims-delhi.description: One of the AIIMS network of Institutes of National Importance for medical education, research and tertiary care. Status as of 2026-09-25: Functional. Located in Delhi, Delhi.

in-min-ayush.name: Ministry of AYUSH

in-pcimh.name: Pharmacopoeia Commission for Indian Medicine and Homoeopathy
in-pcimh.description: Sets and publishes official quality/pharmacopoeial standards for Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani and Homoeopathy drugs, and administers their pharmacovigilance.

in-ccras.name: Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences
in-ccras.description: Apex body for Ayurveda research, running a network of national institutes and regional research centres.

in-ccrum.name: Central Council for Research in Unani Medicine
in-ccrum.description: Apex body for research in Unani medicine.

in-ccrh.name: Central Council for Research in Homoeopathy
in-ccrh.description: Apex body for research in Homoeopathy.

in-ccryn.name: Central Council for Research in Yoga and Naturopathy
in-ccryn.description: Apex body for research in Yoga and Naturopathy.

in-ccrs.name: Central Council for Research in Siddha
in-ccrs.description: Apex body for research in Siddha medicine.

in-ncism.name: National Commission for Indian System of Medicine
in-ncism.description: Regulates Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani and Sowa-Rigpa medical education and practitioners (accreditation, curricula, central registers); replaced the Central Council of Indian Medicine in 2021.
in-ncism.legalBasis: National Commission for Indian System of Medicine Act, 2020

in-nch.name: National Commission for Homoeopathy
in-nch.description: Regulates homoeopathic medical education and practitioners; replaced the Central Council of Homoeopathy in 2021.

in-min-education.name: Ministry of Education
aliases: formerly Ministry of Human Resource Development
in-min-education.description: Sets school and higher-education policy for India (curriculum frameworks, NEP 2020 implementation) through two departments — School Education & Literacy, and Higher Education — and regulates entrance exams, universities and technical institutes via UGC, AICTE, NCERT, NTA and others.
in-min-education.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961 (renamed from Ministry of Human Resource Development in 2020)
in-min-education.head: in-pos-minister-education

in-dept-school-education-and-literacy.name: Department of School Education and Literacy
in-dept-school-education-and-literacy.description: Administers school education policy, mid-day meals, teacher education, and boards/bodies such as CBSE, NCERT, NCTE, KVS and NVS.

in-dept-higher-education.name: Department of Higher Education
in-dept-higher-education.description: Administers university and technical-education policy and funding, and bodies such as UGC, AICTE, NTA, IITs, IIMs, NITs and central universities.
